breakdown.description: Components of the effective maker and taker rates in force.

accountDiscounts.description: Account discounts in force on this market, in no particular order. The highest maker discount and the highest taker discount apply, each possibly from a different discount.

allMarkets.description: True when the discount applies to every spot market; false when it applies to selected markets, this one included. A referral discount always applies to every spot market.

effectiveFrom.description: Time from which the discount is in force, inclusive.

effectiveTo.description: Time at which the discount ends, exclusive. Omitted when it has no scheduled end.

makerDiscountPercent.description: Maker fee discount encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, with at most two decimals. It lowers a positive maker rate only.

takerDiscountPercent.description: Taker fee discount encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, with at most two decimals.

marketMultiplier.description: Fee schedule multipliers in force on this market. Omitted when none is in force, which leaves the tier rates unchanged.

effectiveFrom.description: Time from which the fee schedule is in force, inclusive.

effectiveTo.description: Time at which the fee schedule ends, exclusive. Omitted when it has no scheduled end.

makerMultiplierPercent.description: Maker rate multiplier encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive with at most two decimals.

takerMultiplierPercent.description: Taker rate multiplier encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive with at most two decimals.

referralDiscount.description: Referral discount in force for the account. Omitted when none is in force.

tierMakerFeeRatePercent.description: Maker fee rate of the account's VIP tier under the fee policy in force, before the market multiplier and discounts, encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are between -100 and 100 inclusive; a negative rate is a rebate.

tierTakerFeeRatePercent.description: Taker fee rate of the account's VIP tier under the fee policy in force, before the market multiplier and discounts, encoded as a non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive.

makerFeeRatePercent.description: Effective maker fee rate encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are between -100 and 100 inclusive. It is computed from breakdown as SpotFeeRateBreakdown describes.

nextChangeAt.description: Earliest scheduled time at which a component of these rates starts or ends: a fee schedule or discount in breakdown ending, or a VIP tier, fee policy, fee schedule or discount not yet in force starting. The effective and reserve rates can change then, or stay the same. Omitted when no change is scheduled.

postOnlyReserveFeeRatePercent.description: Fee rate a new post-only limit order on this market reserves its fee at when the fee is paid in the quote asset, encoded as a non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive: the highest maker rate of every VIP tier under the fee schedule in force on this market, as reserve_fee_rate_percent describes.

reserveFeeRatePercent.description: Fee rate a new order on this market reserves its fee at when the fee is paid in the quote asset, encoded as a non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive. It is the highest maker or taker rate of every VIP tier under the fee schedule in force on this market, so it is at least the effective rates and discounts never lower it. A buy limit order that pays its fee in the quote asset reserves N + F, computed in units of 10^-18 of the quote asset whatever the quote asset's own decimals: N is its price times its quantity rounded up to 10^-18, and F is N times this rate rounded up to 10^-18. It has sufficient quote balance when N + F is at most the available quote balance, compared in the same 10^-18 units; other order validation and market limits still apply. A post-only limit order reserves at post_only_reserve_fee_rate_percent instead, and a buy sized by a quote amount reserves at the lower of this rate and taker_fee_rate_percent. Fills charge the effective rate, and the rest of the reserve is released as the order fills or ends.

takerFeeRatePercent.description: Effective taker fee rate encoded as a non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are between 0 and 100 inclusive. It is computed from breakdown as SpotFeeRateBreakdown describes.

vipTier.description: VIP tier used to resolve these rates, in the inclusive range 0 through 10.

btcPrices.description: BTC-USDT close prices as decimal strings in USDT, one per timestamp, for example '61000.25'. Enables client-side conversion to BTC denomination without refetch.

bucket.description: Sampling interval between points, such as "5m" or "1h".

endTsSec.description: Last point timestamp in seconds since epoch (UTC).

points.description: Number of aligned points in each returned series.

series.description: Master account first, followed by up to nine owned subaccounts ordered by current equity descending, then Remaining when other subaccounts exist.

equity.description: Equity values as decimal strings in USDT with at most 4 decimal places, for example '10250.1234'. Values align 1:1 with timestamps.

accountId.description: Public account or subaccount ID. Its encoded entity type distinguishes the master account from an owned subaccount. Omitted for Remaining.

remaining.description: True when this series combines all non-selected owned subaccounts.

startTsSec.description: First point timestamp in seconds since epoch (UTC).

accounts.description: Master account first, followed by every owned subaccount ordered by current equity descending and public ID ascending for ties.

accountId.description: Public master-account or subaccount ID.

equity.description: Current equity as a decimal string in USDT with at most 4 decimal places, for example '10250.1234'.

topAssetIds.description: Up to three assets with the highest current equity value, ordered highest first. Assets without a current value are omitted.

assets.description: Non-zero asset balances ordered by current equity descending and public asset ID ascending for ties.

balance.description: Combined Funding and Trading balance as a decimal string in asset units with at most 7 decimal places, for example '1.2345678'.

equity.description: Current equity as a decimal string in USDT with at most 4 decimal places, for example '10250.1234'.

btcPrice.description: Current BTC-USDT price as a decimal string in USDT, for example '61000.25'. '0' when unavailable.

totalEquity.description: Current equity across the master account and all owned subaccounts as a decimal string in USDT with at most 4 decimal places, for example '10250.1234'.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

account.description: Account bucket affected by this transfer.

amount.description: Transfer amount as a decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '0.5'.

balanceAfter.description: Post-transfer balance as a decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '1250.5'.

destination.description: Credit side of the transfer. This relationship is debit-to-credit rather than row-relative; use is_debit to determine whether this row is the credit leg.

accountId.description: Public root account or subaccount ID when this side is safe to identify. Never populated for private counterparties or non-user ledger accounts.

address.description: Address for this side when known. For EXTERNAL_ADDRESS this is an external-chain wallet address from lifecycle correlation; for identifiable Polyester accounts this is a Polyester smart-account address. May be empty until the corresponding lifecycle details are available.

chainId.description: PolyChain-registered external network identifier for EXTERNAL_ADDRESS. This matches chain.zipper.v1.ChainConfig.chain_id and is not the chain's native identifier (for example, an EIP-155 id) or the Polyester chain id.

kind.description: Display classification for this transfer side.

flowId.description: Public lifecycle flow ID when this transfer belongs to a chain lifecycle flow.

isDebit.description: True when this row is the debit leg; false when it is the credit leg.

linkId.description: Correlation ID used to group related transfer legs. Zero when unavailable.

source.description: Debit side of the transfer. This relationship is debit-to-credit rather than row-relative; use is_debit to determine whether this row is the debit leg.

accountId.description: Public root account or subaccount ID when this side is safe to identify. Never populated for private counterparties or non-user ledger accounts.

address.description: Address for this side when known. For EXTERNAL_ADDRESS this is an external-chain wallet address from lifecycle correlation; for identifiable Polyester accounts this is a Polyester smart-account address. May be empty until the corresponding lifecycle details are available.

chainId.description: PolyChain-registered external network identifier for EXTERNAL_ADDRESS. This matches chain.zipper.v1.ChainConfig.chain_id and is not the chain's native identifier (for example, an EIP-155 id) or the Polyester chain id.

kind.description: Display classification for this transfer side.

timestamp.description: Transfer timestamp in microseconds since epoch (UTC).

transferId.description: Stable transfer identifier, an unsigned 128-bit integer as a decimal string. Both legs of a transfer share it; with account_code and is_debit it identifies this row.

candles.description: Primary market candle series, ordered newest-first by ts_sec.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

referenceCandles.description: Composite reference market candle series, ordered newest-first by ts_sec. Populated only when include_reference is true and reference data is available.

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol echoed from the request path, e.g. BTC-USDT.

timeframe.description: Candle bucket size used for the returned series.

assets.description: Assets ordered by asset code in ascending alphabetical order.

includedInEquity.description: Counted in the account's total equity. When false, balances of this asset are still reported but carry no value in total equity. Always set; treat an absent value as unknown, never as false.

ledgerId.description: Stable numeric asset id used by account, balance, and order APIs.

marketDataVolumeScale.description: Integer scale for public candle and market-overview base volume (0..18).

quantityDisplayDecimals.description: Suggested decimal precision for displaying user-facing asset amounts.

quantityScale.description: Decimal scale (0..18) for this asset's order quantities and other fields that explicitly reference quantity_scale. A scale of 8 represents one whole asset as 100000000 in those fields. Account balance amounts use fixed 18-decimal units independently of this value.

maxOpenOrdersTotal.description: The venue's default limit on resting orders a typical account may hold across all pairs together: good-till-cancelled and good-till-date orders that have not ended. Immediate-or-cancel, fill-or-kill and market orders never count, and a replaced order keeps its place. An order past it is rejected with MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_TOTAL. Each pair's own limit is PairConfig.max_open_orders_per_pair. An account may have a lower limit of its own; that is not part of this public configuration and would be returned by an account-scoped read.

pairs.description: Pairs ordered by symbol in ascending alphabetical order.

allowBuyFeeFromBase.description: Whether BUY order fees may be paid from the base asset instead of the spent quote asset when the order request selects the base fee asset.

baseAsset.description: Base asset code. For BTC-USDT, this is "BTC".

baseQuantityScale.description: Quantity scale for base-asset amounts in this pair.

defaultMarketSlippageBpsBuy.description: Default MARKET order slippage cap for BUY orders, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). A request-level slippage setting can override this value.

defaultMarketSlippageBpsSell.description: Default MARKET order slippage cap for SELL orders, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). A request-level slippage setting can override this value.

delistingAt.description: Scheduled delisting timestamp. When unset, the pair has no explicit delisting time.

listingAt.description: Scheduled listing timestamp. When unset, the pair has no explicit future listing time.

marketdata.description: Market-data display settings for this pair.

orderbookPriceBuckets.description: Suggested order book aggregation bucket sizes in quote-asset price units, e.g. 0.01, 0.1, 1, or 10.

maxClientRefDriftBps.description: Maximum allowed drift between client reference price and server reference price for MARKET orders, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), when client reference pricing is used.

maxLimitQtyBase.description: Largest quantity of one limit order, as a decimal string in base-asset units. A replace is checked on its new total less the quantity already filled. An order above it is rejected with MAX_QTY. Absent when the pair has no maximum.

maxMarketNotionalQuote.description: Additional maximum notional for market orders as a decimal string in quote-asset units. Base-sized market orders are valued at the buy protection price or the sell reference price before slippage, without rounding. For quote-sized market buys, the entire all-in maximum quote debit must also fit this maximum. Exceeding it returns MAX_NOTIONAL. Absent when no maximum is configured.

maxMarketQtyBase.description: Largest quantity of one market order, as a decimal string in base-asset units. A market order sized by quote amount is checked once converted to base. An order above it is rejected with MAX_QTY. Absent when the pair has no maximum.

maxOpenOrdersPerPair.description: The venue's default limit on resting orders a typical account may hold on this pair at once: good-till-cancelled and good-till-date orders that have not ended. Immediate-or-cancel, fill-or-kill and market orders never count, and a replaced order keeps its place. An order past it is rejected with MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_PER_PAIR. An account may have a lower limit of its own; that is not part of this public configuration and would be returned by an account-scoped read.

maxOrderNotionalQuote.description: Maximum per-order notional as a decimal string in quote-asset units. Base-sized orders are checked using quantity times limit price, or market protection price, without rounding. For quote-sized buys, the entire all-in maximum quote debit must also fit this maximum. Exceeding it returns MAX_NOTIONAL. Absent when no maximum is configured.

minNotionalQuote.description: Minimum order notional as a decimal string in quote-asset units.

minQtyBase.description: Minimum order quantity as a decimal string in base-asset units.

quoteAsset.description: Quote asset code. For BTC-USDT, this is "USDT".

quoteQuantityScale.description: Quantity scale for quote-asset amounts in this pair.

referencePriceScale.description: Integer scale for composite reference prices in candle responses (0..18). Primary market and execution prices use the fixed scale 9.

stepSize.description: Minimum allowed quantity increment as a decimal string in base-asset units.

symbolId.description: Stable numeric pair id used by low-latency ConnectRPC requests and streams.

tickSize.description: Minimum allowed price increment as a decimal string in quote-asset units. Prices use 9 decimal places in scaled integer fields; for example "0.01" means orders must be priced in 0.01 quote-asset increments.

tsSec.description: Snapshot generation timestamp, in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

completeThroughTradeId.description: With afterTradeId only: every trade with matchId at or below it exists and is returned by this endpoint.

epochEnds.description: Set only with after_trade_id. Every epoch whose last trade (or, for an epoch without trades, its start) lies between after_trade_id and next_after_trade_id, both inclusive, ascending by epoch. A page that ends exactly on an epoch's last trade is followed by a page that still reports that epoch's end.

lastTradeId.description: match_id of the epoch's last trade; (epoch-1) * 2^40 when the epoch ended without trades.

nextAfterTradeId.description: With afterTradeId only: the afterTradeId of the next call. It never moves backwards; equal to the request's afterTradeId when nothing newer is available yet.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist, and always empty with after_trade_id.

trades.description: Trades ordered newest-first by execution timestamp, with match_id as a tie-breaker; with after_trade_id, ascending by match_id.

executedAt.description: Trade execution timestamp, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

matchId.description: Stable trade id within the symbol, suitable for pagination and de-duplication.

price.description: Trade price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'.

qty.description: Traded quantity as a decimal string in base asset units, for example '0.001'.

side.description: True when the taker/aggressor bought the base asset; false when the taker/aggressor sold the base asset.

symbol.description: Stable numeric pair id from GetSpotConfig.

fiat.description: Supported fiat currencies, including USD, ordered by code.

code.description: Uppercase currency or stablecoin code, such as EUR or USDT.

fractionDigits.description: Default display fraction digits, including zero for currencies such as JPY. This is a formatting default, not rate precision, token decimals, or cash rounding. Stablecoins use two display fraction digits.

symbol.description: Representative local display symbol; multiple currencies may share a symbol. Uses the code when the selected local display data has no distinct visible symbol.

stablecoins.description: Supported stablecoins (USDC and USDT), ordered by code.

code.description: Uppercase currency or stablecoin code, such as EUR or USDT.

fractionDigits.description: Default display fraction digits, including zero for currencies such as JPY. This is a formatting default, not rate precision, token decimals, or cash rounding. Stablecoins use two display fraction digits.

symbol.description: Representative local display symbol; multiple currencies may share a symbol. Uses the code when the selected local display data has no distinct visible symbol.

fiat.description: Complete fiat snapshot; absent until a complete snapshot has been observed.

rates.description: Complete fiat rates, including USD, ordered by code.

unitsPerUsd.description: Fiat currency units per 1 USD as an exact decimal string.

sourceTsSec.description: Shared source observation time in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

stale.description: True once the source observation is at least two hours old.

snapshotTsSec.description: Response construction time in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

stablecoins.description: Observed stablecoin rates ordered by code. Unobserved stablecoins are omitted.

sourceTsSec.description: This stablecoin's source observation time in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

stale.description: True once this stablecoin's source observation is at least five seconds old.

usdPerUnit.description: USD per 1 stablecoin unit as an exact decimal string.

bucket.description: Sampling interval between points; currently always "15m".

endTsSec.description: Last sample timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch (UTC), inclusive.

pairs.description: Pairs ordered by ascending symbol_id; at most 2000, each included once.

symbolId.description: Stable pair ID. Pairs are ordered by ascending ID, each included exactly once.

volumeUsd.description: Trailing-24h USD volume as decimal strings. Exactly points values aligned with the shared grid, oldest first. Zero means no executed trades.

points.description: Number of aligned values in every pair array and the total array; always 97.

startTsSec.description: First sample timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch (UTC), inclusive.

totalVolumeUsd.description: Total trailing-24h USD volume as decimal strings. Exactly points values, oldest first, aligned with every pair. Index i maps to startTsSec + i * 900 seconds. Zero means no trades; unavailable valuations fail the request.

markets.description: Market overview rows for the requested page.

bestAsk.description: Current best ask price as a decimal string in quote asset units.

bestAskQty.description: Best ask quantity as a decimal string in base asset units.

bestBid.description: Current best bid price as a decimal string in quote asset units.

bestBidQty.description: Best bid quantity as a decimal string in base asset units.

change24hBps.description: Rolling 24h change expressed in basis points (bp). Example: +123 = +1.23%. Measured from the 24h open to the last price, at minute granularity: the 24h open is the price at the start of the minute that contains the time 24h ago or, for a market that first traded later, its first trade. 0 when the market has no trade yet (its last trade timestamp is 0 too) and until its first minute of trading has ended.

high24h.description: Highest traded price in the rolling 24h window, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

indexPrice.description: Current multi-venue index price as a decimal string in quote asset units. Zero when no fresh, valid index price is available.

lastPrice.description: Last traded price as a decimal string in quote asset units, for example '28334.99'.

lastTradeTsNs.description: Last trade timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

listedTsNs.description: Listing timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch. 0 when the pair has no listing time.

low24h.description: Lowest traded price in the rolling 24h window, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

close.description: Newest-first close prices as decimal strings in quote asset units.

interval.description: Time range and sampling resolution represented by these close prices.

volume24hBase.description: Rolling 24h base volume as a decimal string in base asset units. Omitted when the volume exceeds the supported range.

volume24hQuote.description: Rolling 24h executed quote volume as a decimal string in quote asset units. Omitted when the volume exceeds the supported range.

volume24hUsd.description: Rolling 24h USD volume as a decimal string in USD with up to 6 decimal places. Applies the current quote/USD conversion to the rolling quote volume. When conversion is unavailable, USDT and USDC are valued at USD parity. Omitted for other quote assets when a current conversion is unavailable.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

asks.description: Best ask first; ascending price. When available is true, empty means no current liquidity; when it is false, always empty.

available.description: True when the book is current and empty sides mean no liquidity. False while the book is being built or after it was invalidated: its levels are unknown, not empty. Request the snapshot again later.

bids.description: Best bid first; descending price. When available is true, empty means no current liquidity; when it is false, always empty.

bookSeq.description: Monotonic book sequence for this symbol.

ts.description: Snapshot timestamp as Unix epoch milliseconds; 0 while available is false.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

attachedRisk.description: Attached risk controls + runtime state on the parent order. Empty when no attached risk exists. Order reads include it only when the request asks for it (include_attached_risk, include_attached_risk_state): an omission on request, never a removal. The private WebSocket always carries it in full, as a read asking for both does.

oco.description: True while the parent's legs were placed with oco and both the take-profit and a stop leg (stop-loss or trailing stop) are present. False once either leg is removed. A leg that ended, including one canceled with OCO, stays present.

stopLoss.description: Stop-loss leg, if configured or if state exists.

policy.description: Stop-loss policy configured on the parent order.

child.description: Child execution when the threshold is crossed.

price.description: Limit price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'.

marketIoc.description: Market child with implicit IOC behavior.

triggerPrice.description: Trigger price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '60000'.

triggerPriceSource.description: Price the stop-loss watches. Unspecified or LAST_PRICE watches the last traded price. INDEX_PRICE watches the market's index price; on a market without an index price the order is rejected with terminal reason INDEX_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE before any fill, and a modify that adds such a leg is refused with TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED, leaving the order and its legs unchanged. MARK_PRICE is not supported. A modify naming another source replaces the leg.

status.description: Current runtime lifecycle status for this attached-risk leg.

terminalAt.description: Time the leg reached a terminal state, in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC). Zero if not terminal.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 9999 whichever side the exit trades. An order whose trailing stop sets 10000 is rejected with MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID, because a 100% cap would leave an exit that sells no positive price to sell at.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Positive maximum absolute price delta in Q9 execution-price ticks (1 tick = 1e-9 quote units).

trailingDistance.description: Trailing distance as a decimal price delta in quote asset units, for example '0.5'.

trailingDistanceBps.description: Trailing distance in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

triggerPriceSource.description: Price the trailing stop watches and trails: its peak or trough, activation and fire all follow this price. Unspecified or LAST_PRICE watches the last traded price. INDEX_PRICE watches the market's index price; on a market without an index price the order is rejected with terminal reason INDEX_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE before any fill, and a modify that adds such a leg is refused with TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED, leaving the order and its legs unchanged. avgPx.description: Average execution price across the lineage through this generation, as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '0.000002908714285714': the exact executed quote amount divided by cumQty, rounded half to even at 18 decimal places, trailing zeros trimmed. '0' if no fills.

batchRequestId.description: Batch-replace identity that admitted this order. Zero for other origins.

clientOrderId.description: Client-provided, account-scoped identifier for correlation, lookup, and cancellation. Empty when none was supplied.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

cumQty.description: Cumulative filled quantity across the lineage through this generation, as a decimal string in base asset units, for example '0.0005'.

cumQuote.description: Exact quote amount of the fills across the lineage through this generation, before fees, as a decimal string in quote asset units, for example '3215.5809531728'. For a BUY sized by submittedMaxQuoteDebit, the quote it used is cumQuote plus feeTotal.amount when feeAsset is QUOTE, or minus it when feeTotal.isRebate is true, since a rebate is credited, and cumQuote alone when feeAsset is BASE; submittedMaxQuoteDebit less the quote it used is what it left unspent. '0' if no fills. Each fill settles its quote rounded down to 18 decimal places, so cumQuote is exactly the quote the fills settled when the base asset's quantity scale is at most 9; above that, cumQuote can exceed it by less than 1e-18 per fill.

expireAt.description: Exact UTC expiry time for GTD orders, within the supported signed Unix-nanosecond range from 1677-09-21T00:12:43.145224193Z through 2262-04-11T23:47:16.854775807Z. Omitted for all other time-in-force policies. The order cannot execute when the current time equals this value.

inheritedCumQty.description: Cumulative filled base quantity inherited from predecessors when this replacement was accepted, as a decimal string in base asset units, for example '0.0005'. '0' for the original order and immutable within a generation. cumQty minus this value is the quantity executed by this generation, not the quantity new to a client session.

leavesQty.description: Remaining working quantity as a decimal string in base asset units, for example '0.001'. '0' for terminal orders.

lineage.description: Logical-order identity and requested generation. Always populated by order reads.

generation.description: One-based replacement generation, distinct from per-order state version.

id.description: Stable logical-order ID: the first generation's public order ID. Replace preserves this ID; an independent new order starts a new lineage.

marketClientRefPrice.description: Optional client-side reference price used for MARKET slippage protection, as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'.

marketMaxSlippageBps.description: Optional MARKET max slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

marketMaxSlippageTicks.description: Non-negative MARKET maximum absolute price delta in Q9 execution-price ticks (1 tick = 1e-9 quote units). Zero means no absolute cap is configured.

origQty.description: Current accepted total order quantity, updated by successful modifies, as a decimal string in base asset units, for example '0.001'.

origin.description: Runtime lineage metadata (why the order exists and what generated it).

childSeq.description: Child sequence number for multi-child trigger strategies. Zero when not applicable.

parentOrderId.description: Parent order ID for attached-risk child orders.

scope.description: Broad class describing how the order was created.

triggerId.description: Trigger identifier when the order was created by a trigger.

triggerType.description: Trigger strategy that created this order. Not set for direct orders; JSON and REST responses then omit it.

postOnly.description: True if the order was submitted as post-only (maker-only).

price.description: Limit price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'. '0' for MARKET orders.

submittedMaxQuoteDebit.description: Submitted hard all-in quote debit limit as a decimal string in quote asset units, for example '100'. Present only when that sizing method was submitted.

version.description: Per-order state version: 0 while the order is accepted but not yet on the book (status PENDING), then 1 from its first book state and higher for every later published execution-state change. Higher values identify newer execution state. Fee totals and requested enrichments are not covered by this version and may differ between responses with the same version.

executionsComplete.description: True when the order's trades through its generation, across every page, add up exactly to its cum_qty_scaled. nextPageToken.description: Cursor for the next execution page. Empty when no further rows are visible; this is not a settlement or order-state reconciliation watermark.

limitPrice.description: Maximum price of a trailing stop that buys back, as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '65000': the most its exit pays, at which the quote it may spend is reserved. Present when the parent order sells; omitted when the parent order buys.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 9999 whichever side the exit trades. An order whose trailing stop sets 10000 is rejected with MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID, because a 100% cap would leave an exit that sells no positive price to sell at.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Positive maximum absolute price delta in Q9 execution-price ticks (1 tick = 1e-9 quote units).

trailingDistance.description: Trailing distance as a decimal price delta in quote asset units, for example '0.5'.

trailingDistanceBps.description: Trailing distance in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

triggerPriceSource.description: Price the trailing stop watches and trails: its peak or trough, activation and fire all follow this price. Unspecified or LAST_PRICE watches the last traded price. INDEX_PRICE watches the market's index price; on a market without an index price the order is rejected with terminal reason INDEX_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE before any fill, and a modify that adds such a leg is refused with TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED, leaving the order and its legs unchanged. MARK_PRICE is not supported. A modify naming another source replaces the leg.

cumQty.description: Cumulative filled quantity across the lineage through this generation, as a decimal string in base asset units, for example '0.0005'.

cumQuote.description: Exact quote amount of the fills across the lineage through this generation, before fees, as a decimal string in quote asset units, for example '3215.5809531728'. For a BUY sized by submittedMaxQuoteDebit, the quote it used is cumQuote plus feeTotal.amount when feeAsset is QUOTE, or minus it when feeTotal.isRebate is true, since a rebate is credited, and cumQuote alone when feeAsset is BASE; submittedMaxQuoteDebit less the quote it used is what it left unspent. expireAt.description: Exact UTC expiry time for GTD orders, within the supported signed Unix-nanosecond range from 1677-09-21T00:12:43.145224193Z through 2262-04-11T23:47:16.854775807Z. Omitted for all other time-in-force policies. The order cannot execute when the current time equals this value.

feeTotal.description: Total fee of the fills across the lineage through this generation, net of rebates, in the order's fee asset. isRebate.description: True when the covered fills' rebates exceed their fees, so the amount was credited to the account rather than charged.

oco.description: If true, the take-profit and the configured stop leg (stop-loss or trailing stop) are linked and shown as one-cancels-the-other. Requires a take-profit and exactly one stop leg. The legs of every parent share one position and end together as described on RiskPolicy, so this setting does not change when exits are submitted. It decides what canceling an exit order ends: with oco set, canceling one leg's exit ends both legs; without it, only that leg ends and the other keeps protecting the remaining position. Changing only this setting with ModifyOrder keeps the existing legs, with their IDs, arming and a trailing stop's tracked peak; changing a leg's terms, such as its trigger price, limit price or trailing distance, still replaces that leg. Default is false.

selfTradePreventionMode.description: Self-trade prevention mode against orders of the same root account, including all its subaccounts. Defaults to EXPIRE_MAKER if unspecified.

requestId.description: Required account-scoped idempotency key for the entire ordered batch. Reusing it with the same payload within 15 minutes returns each decided item's original result and result time, and retries the items still unresolved, never admitting an already admitted item again. Reusing it with a different payload during that window returns CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE. After 15 minutes the ID is free: a repeat is a new request and can place its orders again, so read the items back instead of repeating an older batch.

results.description: Per-item results in same order as request.

stopLossTriggerId.description: Trigger ID for attached stop-loss (when accepted and configured).

newAttachedRisk.description: Replacement attached-risk policy for the order.

oco.description: If true, the take-profit and the configured stop leg (stop-loss or trailing stop) are linked and shown as one-cancels-the-other. Requires a take-profit and exactly one stop leg. The legs of every parent share one position and end together as described on RiskPolicy, so this setting does not change when exits are submitted. It decides what canceling an exit order ends: with oco set, canceling one leg's exit ends both legs; without it, only that leg ends and the other keeps protecting the remaining position. Changing only this setting with ModifyOrder keeps the existing legs, with their IDs, arming and a trailing stop's tracked peak; changing a leg's terms, such as its trigger price, limit price or trailing distance, still replaces that leg. Default is false.

requestId.description: Idempotency key (required). Reuse the same key and criteria for retries. Completed results are retained for at least two minutes. Use a fresh key for a new cancellation; do not reuse a key after its replay window.

cancelledOrders.description: Orders whose cancellation was requested, oldest first (the order in which they were created), at most 200. When more orders were canceled, these are the 200 oldest and `truncated` is true; the order update stream and read paths report every one. Empty when `dry_run` is set. Retrying with the same `request_id` and criteria within 120 seconds returns the original status, counts and timestamp, an empty list, and `listing_status = NOT_RETAINED_READ_OPEN_ORDERS`. It requests no new cancellations. Read open orders for current state and use order updates for final outcomes.

clientOrderId.description: The order's client order ID; empty when the order has none.

failedCancels.description: Number of matched orders that could not be submitted for cancellation because the cancel-all could not be recorded for their symbol. This request does not cancel them; send a new cancel-all with a new `request_id` if they are still open. Zero when `dry_run` is set.

listingStatus.description: Availability of the historical listing. An empty retry listing does not change the original counts or mean that no cancellations were requested.

matchedOrders.description: Number of open orders that matched the filter when the request was accepted, including orders whose cancellation was already in progress and open orders that triggers placed. Triggers themselves are never counted. Orders placed after acceptance are not counted. Unless `dry_run` is set, equals `submitted_cancels` plus `failed_cancels`.

submittedCancels.description: Number of matched orders for which cancellation was requested, including orders whose cancellation was already in progress. Observe order updates or reads for final outcomes; orders may execute before cancellation takes effect. Zero when `dry_run` is set.

totalCancelled.description: Number of orders whose cancellation was requested, including those not listed in `cancelled_orders`. Equals `submitted_cancels`. Zero when `dry_run` is set.

truncated.description: True when more orders were canceled than `cancelled_orders` lists.

weekday.description: Run day of a weekly or biweekly rule.

bps.description: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

brokerBps.description: Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none. broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300. Fees outside these rules fail with FEES_INVALID.

destinationAddress.description: Recipient of the swap output on the destination network, in its native text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes.

destinationMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for destination_address. Required when the destination network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

idempotencyKey.description: Broker-chosen idempotency key, 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'. Scoped to the authenticated broker and retained permanently. The same key with the same request returns the same QuickSwap and deposit address; with a different request it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Requests are compared after every valid address and memo is put in its network's canonical form, so the same address in another case or encoding is the same request; affiliate order is ignored; every other field, the fees included, must be equal.

refundAddress.description: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset on the refund route's network, in its native text form without memo. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

refundMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for refund_address. Required when the refund network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

refundZippedAssetId.description: Refund route for the intermediate asset of a two-leg route: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id of the asset whose AssetConfig.ledger_id is the quote's intermediate_asset_id in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config, for example USDT on Ethereum. Required with refund_address when the route has an intermediate asset; optional and unused otherwise.

returnAddress.description: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network, in its native text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes. Deposits that are not accepted, and source funds that are not traded, go here; never to an observed sender.

returnMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for return_address. Required when the source network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

sourceWallet.description: Optional source wallet the end user will deposit from, for brokers that know it in advance. It must be a valid address on the source network, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, and is shown on the QuickSwap.

amount.description: Positive amount in the token units of the route selected by basis: source route for SOURCE_AMOUNT, destination route for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

execution.description: Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only; TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.

durationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when the QuickSwap is created.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded up.

protection.description: Worst execution the end user accepts.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's min_amount_out and min_rate.

minAmountOut.description: Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the quote's min_rate.

quickSwap.description: The QuickSwap, normally AWAITING_DEPOSIT with deposit_instructions. A retry returns its current state with the original quote and address.

chargedFees.description: Broker and affiliate fees charged so far, as settled: one entry per fee kind, credited vault and asset, in kind, then account_id, then asset_id order. Grows while the QuickSwap executes or pays out a bridge. Each is the requested rate applied to the actual execution, so it can differ from the quote's fee lines.

depositInstructions.description: Where and until when to deposit; absent while ALLOCATING and on a QuickSwap that never got an address (EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).

address.description: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.

addressRetiresAt.description: After this time the deposit address is retired and funds sent to it may not be recoverable. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at. After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before funding_expires_at.

addressState.description: Current lifecycle state of the address.

fundingExpiresAt.description: End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time never executes. A deposit observed on a retired address is MANUAL_RECOVERY and is not returned automatically; other late deposits are RETURN_ONLY. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send deposits well before this time. Never changes.

issuedAt.description: When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.

memo.description: Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.

minNativeGasLimit.description: Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for native-coin deposits on EVM networks: 250000. Polyester does not enforce this limit. On some networks, depositing to an address that has never received funds requires far more than 21000 gas. If the limit is too low, the transaction fails on chain without depositing funds, and the network fee is still charged. Use at least the recommended limit. Unused gas is not charged. Zero for token deposits and non-EVM networks.

deposits.description: Detected deposits, oldest first, at most 50.

confirmations.description: Current source-network confirmations; zero until the source network reports any. Never decreases.

creditedAt.description: When the deposit was credited; unset until credited. Credit does not decide eligibility: a credited deposit can still be EVALUATING, and one then found ineligible, such as a late deposit, stays credited and is returned (RETURN_ONLY).

detectedAt.description: When the deposit was first seen. Eligibility compares this time with funding_expires_at.

index.description: Zero-based position in detection order; stable for the QuickSwap's life.

reason.description: Why the disposition is RETURN_ONLY, ON_HOLD or MANUAL_RECOVERY; REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise, and for a deposit ON_HOLD for review without a more specific reason.

requiredConfirmations.description: Source-network confirmations required before credit; zero until known.

txHash.description: Source-network transaction identifier in the network's native text form.

txOccurrenceIndex.description: Output or log index of the deposit within tx_hash; zero is valid.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network actually received, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero until Polyester has identified the deposit's asset, shortly after detection, and when the asset is not a supported route.

depositsTruncated.description: True when more than 50 deposits were detected; only the first 50 are listed.

destinationAddress.description: Recipient of the swap output on the destination network. Addresses and memos are in their network's canonical form (for example lowercase EVM hex), which can differ in case or encoding from the create request; that form is the one paid.

destinationMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for destination_address; empty when none.

execution.description: Execution progress; absent before execution starts.

completedSlices.description: Completed slices: a market execution's one slice completes when execution finishes; a TWAP slice completes once it has traded and is over, so a slot that traded nothing or was skipped never completes. Zero for a bridge.

deadline.description: Execution deadline: started_at plus the TWAP duration, or plus the market execution window. Funds not converted by then are refunded or returned. Independent of the quote validity and the funding window. Unset until the execution is planned, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

feeScheduleVersion.description: Fee schedule version fixed at creation. Every execution or bridge payout of this QuickSwap is charged that version's service fees, whatever later versions change.

fees.description: Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation. With a referral (quote.referral), the broker fee charged is broker_bps less the referral's discount and commission.

affiliates.description: Affiliate fees, in ascending account_id order.

isTerminal.description: True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status never changes. Shortly after it, address_retires_at can still move later, and withdrawal details can be corrected as documented on Withdrawal; another deposit reaching the address also shows as RETURN_ONLY, and another deposit observed on an already retired address shows as MANUAL_RECOVERY. Returns made directly for such deposits are not yet reported in withdrawals; RETURN_ONLY does not confirm a completed return. Read again if the end user reports such a deposit or needs the final retirement time.

quote.description: Quote and protection fixed at creation. Not refreshed on retries. Its amounts and fees stay estimates: the QuickSwap is priced when its deposit is credited, and execution, withdrawals and charged_fees report the actual output and fees.

depositAmount.description: Source amount the quote was computed for, in source token units. Equals the request amount for SOURCE_AMOUNT; computed for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

expiresAt.description: End of the short quote validity, typically seconds to minutes after quoted_at. Display the quote until expires_at. CreateQuickSwap prices the terms again and never fails because a quote expired. After it the price fields are stale; the protection of a created QuickSwap still applies. Independent of the funding window and the execution deadline.

fees.description: Estimated fee components for deposit_amount at quoted_at: each leg's service, broker and affiliate or referral fees, in that order, legs in route order (a bridge has one set, charged at payout), then network fees. Affiliates are in ascending account_id order. Zero fees are omitted. The fees charged are each rate applied to the actual execution and can differ from these amounts; QuickSwap.charged_fees reports the broker and affiliate fees as charged.

accountId.description: AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited with the fee; zero for every other kind, REFERRAL included.

Zero for a direct route or a bridge. When non-zero, CreateQuickSwap requires a refund address for that asset. The route is fixed at creation.

maxDepositAmount.description: Largest deposit that is eligible to execute, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Fixed when the QuickSwap is created. For any other deposit, and for a deposit only partly converted, the guarantee is min_rate on the converted part.

basis.description: Side of the swap that amount denominates.

destinationZippedAssetId.description: Destination asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user receives this asset on this network.

execution.description: Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only; TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.

durationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when the QuickSwap is created.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded up.

protection.description: Worst execution the end user accepts.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's min_amount_out and min_rate.

minAmountOut.description: Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the quote's min_rate.

sourceZippedAssetId.description: Source asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user deposits this asset on this network.

version.description: Monotonic state version: a snapshot with a lower version is older. Zero while ALLOCATING; 1 once the deposit address is issued (AWAITING_DEPOSIT) or allocation ends without one (EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT); every later change increments it.

address.description: Recipient address in the network's native text form. Empty on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, whose recipient Polyester does not record.

amount.description: Amount delivered to address after the network fee, in zipped_asset_id's token units; set once FINALIZED. Like tx_hash, it is the amount recorded for this withdrawal and can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at). Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed (SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED): that return is sent from the deposit address and reports no delivered amount. Unset on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER too.

depositIndex.description: Deposit whose funds this withdrawal moves.

finalizedAt.description: When the withdrawal became final; unset until FINALIZED.

flowId.description: Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this withdrawal, usable with GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. The flow is the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, including a correction made after tx_hash, amount and network_fee stop being updated. Lifecycle flow amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units. For the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed, it is the deposit's flow (Deposit.flow_id), which ends REFUNDED with the return as its transaction. For a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, it is the deposit's flow too, which ends FAILED with reason ZIPPER_COMPLIANCE_TRANSFERRED and the transfer as its transaction.

index.description: Zero-based position in the withdrawals list. Not stable: a withdrawal's position can change between reads, so do not use it as an identifier.

memo.description: Recipient destination tag or memo; empty when the network uses none, and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER.

networkFee.description: Actual network fee withheld from this withdrawal, in the same units; set once FINALIZED. Can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends, like amount. Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed, and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, like amount.

role.description: Why this withdrawal pays its recipient.

submittedAt.description: When the withdrawal was submitted; unset until submitted.

txHash.description: Recipient-network transaction recorded for this withdrawal; empty until the transaction is committed on the recipient network. It can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at) and is not updated after that. For the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, read flow_id.

unsentAmount.description: Set only when state is NOT_SENT: the amount for which no withdrawal was made because it was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network. In zipped_asset_id's token units, rounded down to the token's smallest unit.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key used to create it; resolves a QuickSwap whose create outcome was unknown.

amount.description: Amount credited, in base units of 18 decimals.

assetId.description: Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

depositInstructions.description: Where and until when to deposit; absent while ALLOCATING and on a QuickSwap that never got an address (EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).

address.description: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.

addressRetiresAt.description: After this time the deposit address is retired and funds sent to it may not be recoverable. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at. After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before funding_expires_at.

addressState.description: Current lifecycle state of the address.

fundingExpiresAt.description: End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time never executes. A deposit observed on a retired address is MANUAL_RECOVERY and is not returned automatically; other late deposits are RETURN_ONLY. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send deposits well before this time. Never changes.

issuedAt.description: When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.

memo.description: Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.

minNativeGasLimit.description: Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for native-coin deposits on EVM networks: 250000. Polyester does not enforce this limit. On some networks, depositing to an address that has never received funds requires far more than 21000 gas. If the limit is too low, the transaction fails on chain without depositing funds, and the network fee is still charged. Use at least the recommended limit. Unused gas is not charged. Zero for token deposits and non-EVM networks.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network to deposit; equal to terms.source_zipped_asset_id.

deposits.description: Detected deposits, oldest first, at most 50.

amount.description: Received amount, before the deposit network fee, in zipped_asset_id's token units; unset while zipped_asset_id is zero.

confirmations.description: Current source-network confirmations; zero until the source network reports any. Never decreases.

creditedAt.description: When the deposit was credited; unset until credited. Credit does not decide eligibility: a credited deposit can still be EVALUATING, and one then found ineligible, such as a late deposit, stays credited and is returned (RETURN_ONLY).

detectedAt.description: When the deposit was first seen. Eligibility compares this time with funding_expires_at.

flowId.description: Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this deposit, usable with GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. Lifecycle flow amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units.

index.description: Zero-based position in detection order; stable for the QuickSwap's life.

reason.description: Why the disposition is RETURN_ONLY, ON_HOLD or MANUAL_RECOVERY; REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise, and for a deposit ON_HOLD for review without a more specific reason.

requiredConfirmations.description: Source-network confirmations required before credit; zero until known.

txHash.description: Source-network transaction identifier in the network's native text form.

txOccurrenceIndex.description: Output or log index of the deposit within tx_hash; zero is valid.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network actually received, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero until Polyester has identified the deposit's asset, shortly after detection, and when the asset is not a supported route.

depositsTruncated.description: True when more than 50 deposits were detected; only the first 50 are listed.

destinationAddress.description: Recipient of the swap output on the destination network. Addresses and memos are in their network's canonical form (for example lowercase EVM hex), which can differ in case or encoding from the create request; that form is the one paid.

destinationMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for destination_address; empty when none.

execution.description: Execution progress; absent before execution starts.

completedSlices.description: Completed slices: a market execution's one slice completes when execution finishes; a TWAP slice completes once it has traded and is over, so a slot that traded nothing or was skipped never completes. Zero for a bridge.

inputAmount.description: Credited amount committed to execution, in source token units.

totalSlices.description: Planned slices: a market execution has one once it is planned; a TWAP has its slice count, duration_ms over slice_interval_ms rounded up. Zero until then, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

feeScheduleVersion.description: Fee schedule version fixed at creation. Every execution or bridge payout of this QuickSwap is charged that version's service fees, whatever later versions change.

fees.description: Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation. With a referral (quote.referral), the broker fee charged is broker_bps less the referral's discount and commission.

affiliates.description: Affiliate fees, in ascending account_id order.

accountId.description: Public sub-account ID of an active affiliate vault of the broker (QuickSwapBrokerService.CreateAffiliateVault). Create the vault first: an unknown, disabled or other broker's vault, or the default vault, fails with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN.

bps.description: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

brokerBps.description: Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, credited to the broker's default vault.

idempotencyKey.description: The broker's idempotency key that created this QuickSwap.

isTerminal.description: True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status never changes. Shortly after it, address_retires_at can still move later, and withdrawal details can be corrected as documented on Withdrawal; another deposit reaching the address also shows as RETURN_ONLY, and another deposit observed on an already retired address shows as MANUAL_RECOVERY. Returns made directly for such deposits are not yet reported in withdrawals; RETURN_ONLY does not confirm a completed return. Read again if the end user reports such a deposit or needs the final retirement time.

quote.description: Quote and protection fixed at creation. Not refreshed on retries. Its amounts and fees stay estimates: the QuickSwap is priced when its deposit is credited, and execution, withdrawals and charged_fees report the actual output and fees.

depositAmount.description: Source amount the quote was computed for, in source token units. Equals the request amount for SOURCE_AMOUNT; computed for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

expectedAmountOut.description: Expected destination amount for deposit_amount at quoted_at, after trading fees and both quoted network fees, in destination token units. An estimate, not a guarantee: the delivered amount follows the actual deposit, execution and fees, bounded below only by the protection.

expiresAt.description: End of the short quote validity, typically seconds to minutes after quoted_at. Display the quote until expires_at. CreateQuickSwap prices the terms again and never fails because a quote expired. After it the price fields are stale; the protection of a created QuickSwap still applies. Independent of the funding window and the execution deadline.

fees.description: Estimated fee components for deposit_amount at quoted_at: each leg's service, broker and affiliate or referral fees, in that order, legs in route order (a bridge has one set, charged at payout), then network fees. Affiliates are in ascending account_id order. Zero fees are omitted. The fees charged are each rate applied to the actual execution and can differ from these amounts; QuickSwap.charged_fees reports the broker and affiliate fees as charged.

accountId.description: AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited with the fee; zero for every other kind, REFERRAL included.

amount.description: Fee in zipped_asset_id's token units; for a fee charged in the intermediate asset, in the intermediate asset at its trading precision (amount.decimals). An estimate for deposit_amount at the quoted prices, with trading fees rounded up; the fee charged can be higher or lower.

bps.description: Rate of a trading fee in basis points of what the leg receives; zero for a network fee. The rate, not amount, is what is charged: bps of what the leg actually receives.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network the fee is charged in, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero for a trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, which is charged in the intermediate asset (intermediate_asset_id).

intermediateAssetId.description: Unified asset ID of the intermediate asset of a two-leg route (for example USDT for BTC to SOL): the AssetConfig.ledger_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. Zero for a direct route or a bridge. When non-zero, CreateQuickSwap requires a refund address for that asset. The route is fixed at creation.

maxDepositAmount.description: Largest deposit that is eligible to execute, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Fixed when the QuickSwap is created. A larger deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM). Unset for a bridge, whose deposit no order book bounds.

minAmountOut.description: Guaranteed minimum delivered amount, in destination token units, at the quoted network fees, for a deposit of exactly deposit_amount that fully converts to the destination asset. For any other deposit, and for a deposit only partly converted, the guarantee is min_rate on the converted part.

minDepositAmount.description: Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. A smaller deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM). It is never below the source network's minimum (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config), and differs from ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

minRate.description: Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits, rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the way to the destination asset, the destination output before the withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the quote.

reason.description: Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. When a payout completes but a refund or return was NOT_SENT, the status follows the paid withdrawals (for example COMPLETED) and the reason is REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.

refundMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for refund_address; empty when none.

refundZippedAssetId.description: Refund route (asset and network) of the intermediate asset; zero when none was supplied.

returnAddress.description: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network.

version.description: Monotonic state version: a snapshot with a lower version is older. Zero while ALLOCATING; 1 once the deposit address is issued (AWAITING_DEPOSIT) or allocation ends without one (EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT); every later change increments it.

address.description: Recipient address in the network's native text form. Empty on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, whose recipient Polyester does not record.

amount.description: Amount delivered to address after the network fee, in zipped_asset_id's token units; set once FINALIZED. Like tx_hash, it is the amount recorded for this withdrawal and can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at). Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed (SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED): that return is sent from the deposit address and reports no delivered amount. Unset on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER too.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

depositIndex.description: Deposit whose funds this withdrawal moves.

finalizedAt.description: When the withdrawal became final; unset until FINALIZED.

flowId.description: Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this withdrawal, usable with GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. The flow is the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, including a correction made after tx_hash, amount and network_fee stop being updated. Lifecycle flow amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units. For the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed, it is the deposit's flow (Deposit.flow_id), which ends REFUNDED with the return as its transaction. For a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, it is the deposit's flow too, which ends FAILED with reason ZIPPER_COMPLIANCE_TRANSFERRED and the transfer as its transaction.

index.description: Zero-based position in the withdrawals list. Not stable: a withdrawal's position can change between reads, so do not use it as an identifier.

memo.description: Recipient destination tag or memo; empty when the network uses none, and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER.

networkFee.description: Actual network fee withheld from this withdrawal, in the same units; set once FINALIZED. Can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends, like amount. Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed, and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, like amount.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. role.description: Why this withdrawal pays its recipient.

submittedAt.description: When the withdrawal was submitted; unset until submitted.

txHash.description: Recipient-network transaction recorded for this withdrawal; empty until the transaction is committed on the recipient network. It can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at) and is not updated after that. For the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, read flow_id.

unsentAmount.description: Set only when state is NOT_SENT: the amount for which no withdrawal was made because it was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network. In zipped_asset_id's token units, rounded down to the token's smallest unit.

bps.description: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

brokerBps.description: Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none. broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300. Fees outside these rules fail with FEES_INVALID.

execution.description: Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only; TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded up.

protection.description: Worst execution the end user accepts.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's min_amount_out and min_rate.

minAmountOut.description: Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the quote's min_rate.

expiresAt.description: End of the short quote validity, typically seconds to minutes after quoted_at. Display the quote until expires_at. CreateQuickSwap prices the terms again and never fails because a quote expired. After it the price fields are stale; the protection of a created QuickSwap still applies. Independent of the funding window and the execution deadline.

fees.description: Estimated fee components for deposit_amount at quoted_at: each leg's service, broker and affiliate or referral fees, in that order, legs in route order (a bridge has one set, charged at payout), then network fees. Affiliates are in ascending account_id order. Zero fees are omitted. The fees charged are each rate applied to the actual execution and can differ from these amounts; QuickSwap.charged_fees reports the broker and affiliate fees as charged.

accountId.description: AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited with the fee; zero for every other kind, REFERRAL included.

amount.description: Fee in zipped_asset_id's token units; for a fee charged in the intermediate asset, in the intermediate asset at its trading precision (amount.decimals). An estimate for deposit_amount at the quoted prices, with trading fees rounded up; the fee charged can be higher or lower.

bps.description: Rate of a trading fee in basis points of what the leg receives; zero for a network fee. The rate, not amount, is what is charged: bps of what the leg actually receives.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network the fee is charged in, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero for a trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, which is charged in the intermediate asset (intermediate_asset_id).

intermediateAssetId.description: Unified asset ID of the intermediate asset of a two-leg route (for example USDT for BTC to SOL): the AssetConfig.ledger_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. Zero for a direct route or a bridge. When non-zero, CreateQuickSwap requires a refund address for that asset. The route is fixed at creation.

maxDepositAmount.description: Largest deposit that is eligible to execute, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Fixed when the QuickSwap is created. A larger deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM). Unset for a bridge, whose deposit no order book bounds.

For any other deposit, and for a deposit only partly converted, the guarantee is min_rate on the converted part.

minDepositAmount.description: Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. A smaller deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM). It is never below the source network's minimum (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config), and differs from ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. minRate.description: Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits, rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the way to the destination asset, the destination output before the withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the quote.

clientTriggerId.description: Client-provided trigger ID for idempotency, unique per sub-account, pair and trigger type. While the trigger is active and for 60 seconds after it reaches a terminal status, retrying the create with the identical intent returns the same trigger, and a different intent with the same ID returns CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID. After those 60 seconds the ID is free: a create that uses it is a new intent and creates a new trigger. To learn the outcome of an earlier create after that window, read the triggers with ListTriggers, which return each trigger's client_trigger_id, instead of retrying the create. After a create fails with INTERNAL_ERROR, the ID may already be used: a retry then returns CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID and needs a new client trigger ID. At most 36 bytes in UTF-8 (36 ASCII characters); longer IDs are rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

Required when `side` is BUY and set aside for it with the child's fee; at least the activation price, or at least the price it watches (triggerPriceSource) when no activation price is set. A rise that fires above it still fires, and the child fills only at or below it. Must be unset when `side` is SELL. Fixed at create.
