trailingDistance.description: Trailing distance as a decimal price delta in quote asset units, for example '0.5'.

triggerPriceSource.description: Price the trailing stop watches: its activation, its peak or trough and its fire all follow this price. Unspecified or LAST_PRICE watches the last traded price. INDEX_PRICE watches the market's index price; a market without an index price fails the trigger with INDEX_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE. MARK_PRICE is not supported. Fixed at create: to change it, cancel the trigger and create a new one.

version.description: Per-trigger state version: 1 for the trigger's first state, then higher for every later published state change, whether a request or the market caused it. A higher version is always newer, and two copies of a trigger with the same version show the same state. GetTrigger, ListTriggers and realtime trigger updates carry the same version for the same state. List results can briefly lag realtime updates, and after a reconnect or a service recovery a realtime update can repeat an earlier state, so keep the copy of each trigger with the highest version and ignore any copy whose version is not higher than the one you hold.

amount.description: Withdraw amount as a positive decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '0.5' for half a unit. At most 18 decimal places; a nonzero digit beyond the 18th is refused. Send the amount itself, not a count of smaller units: '1' withdraws one whole unit. The signed authorization carries amount_e18, this amount times 10^18, so '0.5' is signed as 5 times 10^17. For TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN, the amount has at most as many decimal places as the destination network token (AssetChainVariant.source_decimals); a finer amount is refused with AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ROUTE_PRECISION before any funds are reserved.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ALL: Allow all current and future markets for this policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ALLOWLIST: Allow only the markets listed on this policy.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_DAILY_REWARD: Allow claiming the main account's daily reward, paid to the main account or a sub-account it owns. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREATE_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS: Allow creating a deposit address within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW: Allow value to leave Trading through external withdrawals. Destination authorization is enforced separately from this policy. Moves value out of the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_TRANSFER: Allow internal transfers between sub-accounts or linked Polyester accounts, including reading internal transfer history. Moves value out of the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK: Allow creating, updating, deleting, and copying saved destination entries, including reading the address book. Address-book writes accept only a session token, so on an API-key policy this grants address-book reads only. It manages where value can leave the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW: Allow creating, changing, and disabling the auto-withdraw rule, including reading it. A rule pays value out, so changing one also requires EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW, API keys can never change one, and an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ACCOUNT_DIRECTORY: Allow resolving an account by username, account ID, or smart-account address. Any key of the main account may use it, whatever its scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ADDRESS_BOOK: Allow reading saved, recent, and whitelisted address-book destinations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_API_KEYS: Allow listing and reading API keys. A key scoped to the main account sees the main account's keys and those of its sub-accounts; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only that sub-account's keys. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_API_POLICIES: Allow listing and reading API-key policies. A key scoped to the main account sees every API-key policy of the main account; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only the policies attached to that sub-account's keys. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_AUTO_WITHDRAW: Allow reading the auto-withdraw rule and its runs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_BALANCES: Allow reading balances and equity for a sub-account or API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_CHECKPOINTS: Allow reading the main account's checkpoints. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_DAILY_CLAIMS: Allow reading the main account's daily reward claim status. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_DEPOSIT_ADDRESSES: Allow listing the deposit addresses within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_GUARD_SIGNER_STATUS: Allow reading the Guard Signer status within the key's scope; a key never reads another main account's Guard Signer. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PROFILE: Allow reading the main account's profile and username history. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_REWARDS: Allow reading the main account's published reward awards. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SOCIAL_VERIFICATION: Allow reading the main account's social verification status: provider, handle, status, and verification time. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SPOT: Allow reading spot orders and trades, subscriptions, and cancel-all dry-run. Strictly non-mutating: cancellation and cancel-all-after changes require TRADE_SPOT.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNTS: Allow listing and reading the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_ACTIVITY: Allow reading the activity of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_INVITES: Allow listing the outgoing invites of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_MEMBERS: Allow listing the members of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSIONS: Allow reading what the key itself may do on a sub-account within its scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES: Allow listing and reading sub-account policies. A key scoped to the main account sees every sub-account policy of the main account; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only the policy attached to that sub-account. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_VIP_STATUS: Allow reading the main account's VIP status. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_WITHDRAW_VALIDATION: Allow validating an external withdraw destination within the key's scope without creating, signing, or reserving a withdraw. It does not allow withdrawing. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SWAP: Allow quoting, creating, and reading Swaps: market conversions of the account's own Trading balance from one asset into another. Each Swap places spot orders on the account's behalf, which also remain subject to the sub-account's spot trading policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADE_SPOT: Allow all spot order mutations: create, modify, replace, cancel, batch operations, live cancel-all, and arming or disabling cancel-all-after. Includes reading spot orders and trades and placing or modifying triggers. Authorized cancellation remains available when trading activity is disabled; this does not grant mutation access to a read-only API key.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BIWEEKLY: Every two weeks on weekday at minute_of_day UTC: in the week of anchor_date and every second week before or after it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DAILY: Once a day at minute_of_day UTC.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HOURLY: Checked every hour at minute_of_hour UTC; pays only an asset whose payable amount has reached its minimums, so a payout follows within the hour of the balance reaching them. An hour with nothing to pay records no run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MONTHLY: Once a month on day_of_month at minute_of_day UTC. A month without that day runs on its last day: day 31 runs on April 30 and on February 28 or 29, and days 29 and 30 run on the last day of February.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WEEKLY: Once a week on weekday at minute_of_day UTC.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NO_DESTINATION: Nothing would pay, and every positive balance is in an asset the rule has no destination for.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAUSED: The rule is paused, by a person or by itself (see pause); no run starts until it is resumed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ROLLS_OVER: Nothing would pay: every asset with a destination is below its minimum or the rule's USD minimum, has no current price for that minimum, or pays a broker vault's destination that is still cooling down. The balance stays on the account for a later run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WILL_PAY: At least one asset would pay.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Every payout completed or was skipped, and at least one paid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Every attempted payout failed. Each failed step says where its funds are (FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTIALLY_FAILED: Some payouts failed. Each failed step says where its funds are (FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYING: The run's payouts are in progress.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PLANNED: The run is reading the account's balances.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: Nothing was paid: every asset was below its minimum, no current price valued it, or the rule was no longer current.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: The withdrawal failed. Where its funds are depends on when it failed, which its withdrawal flow shows: - before it left the account: they stay on the account; - rejected by Zipper (flow REFUNDED, reason ZIPPER_VALIDATION_REJECTED or ZIPPER_EXECUTION_REJECTED): amount_e18 less network_fee_e18 is refunded, as zTokens, to the account's smart account wallet, not to the account's balance, and the network fee is not refunded; - its execution failed after its destination transaction was sent (flow FAILED, reason ZIPPER_WITHDRAW_EXECUTION_FAILED): Zipper reviews it and settles it outside Polyester Chain; nothing is returned to the account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: Nothing was paid for this asset in this run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Withdrawal accepted; waiting for it to complete on chain.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DENYLISTED_ADDRESS: The destination is blocked by Polyester's user-safety denylist.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ADDRESS: The address is not valid for the selected destination chain.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLYESTER_SMART_ACCOUNT: The destination is a Polyester smart account and cannot be used for an external-chain withdraw.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TOKEN_CONTRACT: The destination is a token contract and cannot receive withdrawals.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN: The selected destination chain is not supported for withdraws.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VALID: The destination is valid and may be used for a withdraw.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_SUPPORTED: A memo or destination tag must be empty.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OPTIONAL: A memo or destination tag may be supplied.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REQUIRED: A memo or destination tag must be supplied.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BREAKING_CHANGE: Breaking change: existing integrations may need to change.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_DATA: Market data: prices, candles, order book, heatmaps and market overviews.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REWARDS: Rewards: daily claims, campaigns, VIP tiers and fee discounts.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADING: Orders, triggers and protective orders, and order outcomes.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.UTC_DAILY: One claim is available to each root account per UTC calendar day.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AVAILABLE: Today's reward is available to claim.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_DELAYED: Today's claim is recorded but its payout is delayed. It is retried and paid automatically; the payout delay reason gives the cause.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROCESSING: Today's claim is being processed. Retrying returns the same claim.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNAVAILABLE: No reward is active for the current UTC day.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Today's claim is recorded and its reward payout was submitted, but its result could not be confirmed. The claim is never paid twice: read the claim status, or retry the claim to get its current state. The error detail names the claim.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_PAYOUT_UNAVAILABLE: Reward payouts for this campaign are paused. Today's claim is kept and paid automatically once payouts resume.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: The claim reward is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE: No reward is available for the current UTC day.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT: The request encountered concurrent claim activity. Retry the request.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED_PRECONDITION: A required condition for completing the claim was not satisfied.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: The request failed because of an unexpected server error.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PERMISSION_DENIED: The claim request was not permitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The applicable request rate limit was exceeded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The REST request body exceeds the 1 KiB limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unable to complete the request.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOCIAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Verify an X or Discord account before claiming a reward.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT_INACTIVE: The selected subaccount is owned by the authenticated root account but is not active.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: The selected subaccount does not exist or is not owned by the authenticated root account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNAUTHENTICATED: The request carries no valid session token or API-key signature.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_ADDRESS: External wallet or chain address. The address is lifecycle-derived and may be empty until ledger-to-lifecycle correlation is projected.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ACCOUNT: Fee ledger side, for example spot or perp trading fees.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRIVATE_COUNTERPARTY: Private off-chain counterparty that must not be identified to the caller. account_id and address are intentionally omitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYSTEM_ACCOUNT: System, operator, clearing, or other non-user side.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ENABLED: New orders and cancellations are accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HALTED: Trading is halted: only cancellations are accepted, and new orders are rejected with MARKET_HALTED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY: New orders must use a post-only execution variant.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REDUCE_ONLY: New spot orders are blocked by reduce-only policy.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.1h: 1 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 60 points (1-minute buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.1mo: 1 month sparkline. Typically returns up to 180 points (4-hour buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.1w: 1 week sparkline. Typically returns up to 168 points (1-hour buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.24h: 24 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 96 points (15-minute buckets).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_CONFIGURED: No leg configured on the parent order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RUNNING: Trigger is executing runtime work (for example multi-step workflows).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: The cancellation request was accepted for processing.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ADMITTED: Every requested operation was admitted, amended items included.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTIALLY_ADMITTED: Some requested replacements were admitted and others were rejected.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ADMITTED: The operation was admitted and handed to execution. action_taken tells whether the order was amended under its own order ID or replaced by a successor.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REJECTED: The replacement was rejected before execution handoff.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ARMED: The dead-man switch is armed or refreshed.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INCLUDED: The initial response includes its listing, possibly empty, up to 200 orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_RETAINED_READ_OPEN_ORDERS: A retry returns its original outcome and counts without the historical listing. Read open orders for current state and use order updates for final outcomes. No new cancellations are requested by the retry.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DRY_RUN: The request only counted matching orders and submitted no cancellations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Matching cancellation requests were submitted for processing.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: The cancellation request was accepted for processing.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_REPAIR: Canceled by the exchange while it recovered the account. Place new orders once the account trades again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_EXIT_FIRED: The order's attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop fired while the order still rested: the exchange canceled the order's unfilled remainder before placing the attached order, so the two never trade with each other. Fills before the cancel stand.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_RISK_REFUSED: The market refused one of the order's attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing-stop legs, so the order's remainder and its other legs were canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_ALL_AFTER: The account's cancel-all-after timer reached its deadline without a heartbeat.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.GTD_EXPIRED: A good-till-date order reached its expiry time.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.IOC_REMAINDER: The unfilled remainder of an immediate-or-cancel order. A buy sized by a quote amount (max_quote_debit_scaled) that spends that amount ends FILLED instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_HALTED: The market was halted: the exchange canceled every open order of the market. Fills before the cancel stand. The market refuses new orders until it trades again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_REMAINDER: The unfilled remainder of a market order: the book ran out, the next price was past the order's protection price, or the order reached the market's maximum order quantity. A market buy sized by a quote amount (max_quote_debit_scaled) that spends that amount, so that what is left buys no further quantity step, ends FILLED instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN: The market was disabled: the exchange canceled its resting orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QTY_AT_OR_BELOW_FILLED: An amend or replace set the order's total quantity at or below its filled quantity, so the order ended at its filled quantity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REPLACED: A replace ended this order and created its successor.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STP_EXPIRE_BOTH: Self-trade prevention canceled both this order and the order belonging to the same root account, including another subaccount of that root, that it would have matched.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STP_EXPIRE_MAKER: Self-trade prevention canceled this resting order when an incoming order belonging to the same root account, including another subaccount of that root, would have matched it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STP_EXPIRE_TAKER: Self-trade prevention canceled this incoming order instead of matching a resting order belonging to the same root account, including another subaccount of that root.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STRATEGY_CANCEL: An order a trigger placed, such as a TWAP slice, a ladder level, a stop's child or an attached leg's exit, canceled because its trigger ended or another leg took over the exit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYSTEM: The exchange canceled the order for a reason it does not name.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP_ROLLOVER: A TWAP slice its TWAP canceled at the next slice's due time; its unfilled remainder moves to the TWAP's later slices.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.USER_REQUEST: A cancel the account sent: a cancel, a batch cancel or a cancel-all.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ORDERS_SUSPENDED: New orders, changes and trigger orders on this account are suspended until a balance issue is resolved; cancels still work. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_REPAIRING: This account's orders are being canceled while its balances are brought back in line, so new orders, changes and trigger orders are paused for a short time. Nothing changed; cancels still work. Try again shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_RESERVATION_LIMIT_REACHED: The account's open orders and triggers hold its maximum number of fund reservations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ROUTING_INVALID: The account's trading route is not configured for triggers, so the trigger was not admitted. Contact support if it persists.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: Referenced account could not be resolved by the trading service.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_MARKET_DENY: API key policy does not allow trading this market, even though the sub-account policy does.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_POLICY_REQUIRED: API key must have an attached policy before it can be used for trading.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_ROOT_SCOPE_ONLY: API key is scoped to the master/root account and cannot trade on sub-accounts.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SPOT_READ_DENY: API key policy does not allow reading spot data.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SUBACCOUNT_MISMATCH: API key is scoped to a different sub-account than the one requested.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SUB_SCOPE_ONLY: API key is scoped to a specific sub-account and cannot trade on the master/root account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_UNKNOWN: API key referenced in the request could not be resolved by the Orders service.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_EXIT_WORKING: An exit order placed by one of the order's attached take-profit or stop legs is still working, so the order's attached legs can't be added, edited, paused or resumed now; removing a leg is still accepted. Nothing changed; retry once the exit completes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_LEGS_EXCEEDED: The order already carries every attached leg it may hold, so another attached leg was refused. Legs being cancelled count until they end: retry once they have ended.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_RISK_NOT_SUPPORTED: Attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing legs can't be applied here: this market takes none, an attached trailing stop isn't offered yet, or the modify changes them together with the order's price, quantity, client order ID or a replace. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_PRICE: Price is invalid for the requested order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_QTY: Quantity is invalid for the requested order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_REQUEST: Request could not be parsed or was structurally invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_OTHER_ITEM_INVALID: Another item of the same batch was invalid, so this item was not applied either. Nothing in the batch changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_REPLACE_ONLY_REQUIRED: No longer returned: each BatchReplaceOrders item follows ModifyOrder's default amend-or-replace rule. The value stays reserved.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_SINGLE_SYMBOL_REQUIRED: An item of the batch modify named no symbol, or another symbol than the batch's first item, so the batch was refused.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_TOO_LARGE: Batch size exceeds the maximum allowed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_ALL_AFTER_SCOPE_CONFLICT: A cancel-all-after is already due to fire, and the re-arm's scope does not cover every symbol of the pending one.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_ALL_AFTER_TIMEOUT_INVALID: The cancel-all-after timeout is neither 0, which disarms it, nor between 10 and 120 seconds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_REQUEST_EXPIRED: The cancel request exceeded its bounded internal replay window.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE: The cancel-all request named more than 100 symbols.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_ORDER_INCONSISTENT: The trigger's child order did not match the order the trigger requested, so the trigger failed and the child order was canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_QTY_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: The new quantity of a TWAP order's slice would leave more than the TWAP's remaining quantity. Nothing changed; a slice can be raised up to what the TWAP still has to execute.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_QTY_RAISE_NOT_ALLOWED: The quantity of a trigger's child order or a ladder order can't be raised above its planned quantity. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_ORDER_IDS_EXHAUSTED: The account reserves its maximum number of client order IDs, including those of recently ended orders. Retry once they expire, or send the request without a client order ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_ORDER_ID_CAPACITY_REACHED: The venue's capacity for reserved client order IDs is exhausted right now, so the trigger's child order could not reserve one. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID_INVALID: The client trigger ID is empty, longer than 36 bytes or otherwise not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_FLAGS_INVALID: The trigger's condition flags were not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_PARAMETER_SET: The trigger set a condition parameter its condition does not take.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ORDER_ID: Client order ID is already in use on this account, by an open order or by an order that ended recently; an ended order keeps its client order ID reserved for at least 60 seconds. Reuse returns this code even with the same payload. Use GetOrder to reconcile, then retry with a new client order ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID: Client trigger ID is already used, either by a trigger with a different payload or by an earlier create that failed or was rolled back. List triggers to reconcile by client trigger ID, then retry with a new client trigger ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DRY_RUN_INVALID: The cancel-all request's dry-run flag was neither 0 nor 1.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID: The order identifier assigned to the request is already in use by another order of the market. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EMPTY_BOOK: Market order could not execute due to empty book.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_INVALID: The trigger's fee asset was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_NOT_ALLOWED: Requested fee asset is not allowed for this order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_CEILING_INVALID: The trigger's maximum fee rate was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE: The fees that apply to the order cannot be determined right now, so it was not admitted. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FOK_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: FOK order rejected due to insufficient immediate liquidity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.GATEWAY_MISCONFIGURED: The trading gateway that took the request is misconfigured for the order service behind it. An operator must correct it; retrying does not help.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Account does not have enough available balance for the order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTENT_ID_INVALID: The cancel-all or cancel-all-after request carried an intent identifier of zero.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: Order processing failed because of an unexpected error.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CLIENT_ORDER_ID: The client order ID is longer than 36 bytes or otherwise not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_HANDLING_MODE: The order handling mode is not a known or accepted mode.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MODIFY_BEHAVIOR: The modify behavior is not a known behavior.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_FLAGS: An order flag is unknown, or not accepted with this order type or time in force, or on a trigger's child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_ID: The order identifier or the replacement order identifier is not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_TYPE: The order type, or a trigger's child order type, is not a known order type.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SIDE: The order side, or a trigger's child order side, is not a known side.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_STP_MODE: The self-trade prevention mode is not a known mode.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIME_IN_FORCE: The time in force, or its expiry time, is not accepted for this order or for a trigger's child order type.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TRIGGER_CONTROL: The requested trigger operation is not a known operation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TRIGGER_TYPE: The trigger type is not a known type.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_LEVELS_INVALID: A ladder places from 2 to 100 orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_LEVEL_REJECTED: One of the ladder's orders can't be placed, so the ladder was not created. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_RANGE_TOO_NARROW: The ladder's price range is too narrow to place its orders at least one price tick apart.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LIMIT_CHILD_SLIPPAGE_SET: The TWAP sets a slippage bound, but its slices are LIMIT orders, which take none.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_LADDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The account already has the most ladder orders one account may have on this market. Nothing changed; retry once one of them ends.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: MARKET BUY cannot be reserved because no reference/top-of-book price is available.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_QUOTE_STALE: The market order carried no client reference price, and the pair's reference quote (top of book) was older than its freshness bound when the order was admitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_QUOTE_UNHEALTHY: The market order carried no client reference price, and the pair's reference quote could not be used to price it, for example because it postdated the order or carried an invalid price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_TRIGGER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The account already has the most triggers one account may have on this market, attached take-profit, stop-loss and trailing legs included. Nothing changed; retry once one of them ends.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_TWAP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The account already has the most TWAP orders one account may have on this market. Nothing changed; retry once one of them ends.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_NOTIONAL: Order notional is above the pair maximum (quote units). A stricter sub-account policy cap returns POLICY_MAX_NOTIONAL instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_PER_PAIR: The account has reached its maximum number of resting orders in this market. Good-till-cancelled and good-till-date orders count until they end; immediate-or-cancel, fill-or-kill and market orders never count, and a replace keeps its order's place. Nothing changed; cancel a resting order in this market first.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_TOTAL: The account has reached its maximum number of open orders across all markets. A stricter sub-account policy cap returns POLICY_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_QTY: Quantity is above the pair maximum: the market-order maximum for MARKET orders, the limit-order maximum otherwise (base units).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_QUOTE_DEBIT_TOO_SMALL: The all-in quote budget cannot resolve one valid step-aligned base quantity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID: Max slippage (ticks or bps) is out of range or leaves no valid execution price bound. Applies to market orders and to standalone and attached trailing stops, on create and on modify; for example, a 10000 bps cap on a market order or trailing stop that sells.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_NOTIONAL: Order notional is below the pair minimum.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_QTY: Quantity is below the pair minimum quantity (base units).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MODIFICATION_REQUIRES_REPLACE: Modify request in AMEND_ONLY mode requires replace semantics.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NEW_ACCOUNT_CAPACITY_REACHED: The venue holds its maximum number of account access records, so an account trading this market for the first time cannot be admitted. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_FOUND: Requested order or resource was not found.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_TERMINAL: The order has already ended (filled, canceled or expired).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CANCEL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The order cancellation was sent but not confirmed in time. Its outcome is unknown and it may still apply; read the order before retrying. For a batch cancellation, every item's outcome is unknown; read them back. For a cancel all, some or all of the matching orders may be canceled; read open orders. For a cancel all after heartbeat, the switch may or may not have been armed, refreshed or disabled; send the heartbeat again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CREATE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The order was sent but not confirmed in time. Its outcome is unknown and it may have been accepted; read the order by its client order ID, or read open orders, before retrying. For a batch create, every item's outcome is unknown; read them back, or repeat the batch with the same request ID and payload within 15 minutes, which returns decided items' original results and retries the rest without admitting any item twice.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ID_CONFLICT: The order identifier is held by a different, earlier order, so the request was not applied. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_LIMITS_UNAVAILABLE: This market's order limits aren't set yet, so it can't take new orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_MODIFY_IN_PROGRESS: An earlier amend or replace of the order has not completed yet. A batch replace answer means its items were admitted, not completed, so the next refresh of the same order can get this code. Retry after a short backoff. For a batch item, resend only that item in a new batch under a fresh request ID, because the rejected batch's request ID returns this rejection again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_MODIFY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The order modification was sent but not confirmed in time. Its outcome is unknown and it may still apply; read the order before retrying. For a batch replacement, every item's outcome is unknown; read them back.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PLACEMENT_PENDING: The placement of the order, or of the replacement an earlier replace created, has not been confirmed yet, so it cannot be modified. It may already rest on the book. A refresh that names the replacement order ID from a batch whose replace has not been confirmed yet gets this code. Retry after a short backoff, as for ORDER_MODIFY_IN_PROGRESS.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_REPAIRING: This order is being canceled while the account's balances are brought back in line, so it can't be changed. Nothing changed; cancels still work, and the account's other orders can still be changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: The account used every order identifier available to it in this market. Retrying does not help; contact support.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_AUCTION: This market is in an auction call and takes only limit orders that rest without crossing the book; market, immediate-or-cancel and fill-or-kill orders are refused. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_UNKNOWN: Referenced order could not be resolved.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OVERLOADED: The account already has its maximum order requests in flight; nothing was admitted. ConnectRPC returns RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (HTTP 429); REST returns HTTP 503. No Retry-After or RateLimit-* headers are supplied. Retry after one of the outstanding requests completes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_BACKLOGGED: The trading pair is busy with the account's earlier requests, so this one was not admitted and nothing was reserved. Retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DELISTED: Pair was delisted and is no longer tradable.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DISABLED: Pair is disabled and does not accept orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_NOT_LISTED_YET: Pair exists but is not listed yet.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_POST_ONLY: Pair is in post-only mode and requires post_only=true.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_REDUCE_ONLY: Pair is in reduce-only mode and does not accept new spot orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PATH_BODY_ID_MISMATCH: A non-empty resource ID in the REST request body differs from the path ID. Nothing changed. Use the same ID in both places, or omit the body ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PERMISSION_DENIED: Caller is authenticated but not allowed to perform this action.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MARKET_DENY: Sub-account policy prevented trading on this market (e.g. pair mask).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_NOTIONAL: Sub-account policy max order notional exceeded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS: Sub-account policy maximum number of open orders has been reached.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_SPOT_READ_DENY: Sub-account policy does not allow reading spot data.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY: Sub-account policy does not allow spot trading (action mask).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_TRADING_HALTED: Trading has been globally halted for this sub-account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: The account's trading policy cannot be evaluated right now, so the order was not admitted. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_CROSS: Post-only order would cross the book.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_LIMIT_ONLY: Post-only is only valid for LIMIT orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_AUCTION: This market is in an auction call; new post-only orders are refused. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_BAND_VIOLATION: Price band guard rejected the order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_LEVELS_EXHAUSTED: The order book of the market holds its maximum number of distinct price levels, so an order at a new price cannot rest. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_LEVEL_QUANTITY_LIMIT: The order would take the total quantity resting at its price past the most a price level can hold, even if some quantity still fits. Nothing changed: a new order was not placed, a modified order keeps resting as it was, and the other orders at that price are unchanged. Another price or a smaller quantity, or the same order once less quantity rests at that price, is accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_TICK_SIZE: Price must align with the pair tick size, including trigger and activation prices.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QTY_AT_OR_BELOW_FILLED: The replacement total quantity is at or below the order's filled quantity: the order ended at its filled quantity and no replacement order was created.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QTY_STEP_SIZE: Quantity does not align with the pair step size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_ACCOUNT_OWNER_UNKNOWN: The QuickSwap account is not ready yet; no order was placed. Retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_ATTACHED_RISK_NOT_ALLOWED: QuickSwap orders can't carry take-profit or stop-loss legs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: The broker's fee account isn't available yet; retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_FEE_TERMS_INVALID: The broker fee terms are invalid and can't be used.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_FEE_TERMS_MISMATCH: The broker fee terms belong to another broker.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_FEE_TERMS_UNAVAILABLE: The broker fee terms aren't available yet; retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_INVALID: The broker's QuickSwap setup is invalid and can't be used.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_CAPACITY_REACHED: QuickSwap's capacity for fee settings is reached; this order can't be placed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_DISABLED: QuickSwap isn't enabled for this account's trading.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_FEE_DETAILS_INCOMPLETE: The request's QuickSwap fee details are incomplete: a fee schedule needs a broker, and a broker or broker fee terms need a fee schedule.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_FEE_RECIPIENT_IS_PAYER: A QuickSwap fee would be paid into the account placing the order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_FEE_SCHEDULE_INVALID: The QuickSwap fee schedule is invalid and can't be used.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_FEE_TOTAL_TOO_HIGH: The QuickSwap fees together would exceed the order's value.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_MARKET_FEE_INVALID: The QuickSwap fee for this market is invalid and can't be used.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_MARKET_NOT_PRICED: The requested QuickSwap fee schedule doesn't price this market.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_NOT_PERMITTED: The request carried QuickSwap terms that the account or market does not accept.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_ORDER_NOT_MODIFIABLE: QuickSwap orders can't be amended or replaced.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_SETUP_INVALID: QuickSwap's setup is invalid, so QuickSwap orders can't be placed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The account exhausted its current order-admission quota.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: No usable rate-limit policy applies to the account right now, so the request was refused rather than admitted unlimited. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REPLACE_ONTO_OWN_ID: The replacement order identifier equals the identifier of the order it replaces.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: The request's receive window ended before it was sent on for admission: the request was not processed and changed nothing. The window is the request's timestamp plus its receive window: the X-API-RECV-WINDOW header of a signed request, or recv_window_ms of a WebSocket command. Send a new request with a fresh timestamp.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_RECEIPTS_EXHAUSTED: The account keeps its maximum number of recent modify or batch requests for duplicate detection. Retry once earlier ones expire.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RESERVATION_CAPACITY_REACHED: The venue's capacity for fund reservations is exhausted right now, so the trigger's child order could not be reserved. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED: Self-trade prevention expired the order of an attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop because it would have traded with another of the account's resting orders. It is reported as the trigger's fire refusal reason, never as the answer to a request: the attached order stays active. New trades and price updates do not fire it while the other order is first in line at the best price; once that order is gone or no longer first there, it fires again if its trigger condition still holds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SETTLEMENT_BACKLOGGED: The account has too many filled or ended orders whose settlement has not completed yet. Nothing changed; the request is accepted again once settlement catches up.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SLIPPAGE_BOUNDS_CONFLICT: The slippage bound is given both in ticks and in basis points; give only one.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SLIPPAGE_BPS_INVALID: The trigger's slippage bound in basis points is not valid for its child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SLIPPAGE_TICKS_INVALID: The trigger's slippage bound in ticks is not valid for its child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STALE_QUOTE: Client reference price is stale compared to server-side BBO/drift policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STP_MODE_NOT_ALLOWED: The self-trade prevention mode is not one the venue accepts for this order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Sub-account is present but not in an active state (disabled, deleted, etc.).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT_READ_FORBIDDEN: Caller has a sub-account role that does not allow reading spot data.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYSTEM_RATE_LIMITED: The venue-wide admission rate that the account shares with other accounts is exhausted. The account's own limit was not reached; retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_CHILD_NOT_MARKET: A trailing stop that sells must have a MARKET child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_DISTANCE_INVALID: Trailing stop distance must be positive.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_SIDE_NOT_SUPPORTED: A trailing stop's side is not supported. Trailing stops accept either side, so this code is not currently returned.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_ACTIVATION_PRICE_INVALID: The trailing trigger's activation price is not positive or not on the pair's tick.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_BUY_REQUIRES_LIMIT: A buy trailing stop's child order is not a LIMIT order with a maximum price; its funds are reserved at that price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_CAPACITY_REACHED: The venue holds its maximum number of triggers across accounts right now. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_CHILD_PRICE_NOT_MODIFIABLE: The modify patched the trigger's child limit price or price mode, which the trigger does not accept.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_CONTROLS_BUSY: The venue's capacity for pending trigger changes is exhausted across accounts. Retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_CONTROL_IN_PROGRESS: An earlier change of the trigger has not completed yet. Retry once it completes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_CONTROL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The trigger change was not confirmed within its time bound. Its outcome is unknown and it may still apply; read the trigger before retrying.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_CONTROL_SHARE_EXHAUSTED: The account has its maximum number of trigger changes whose outcome is still pending. Retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_CREATE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The trigger was sent but not confirmed in time. Its outcome is unknown and it may have been created; read the triggers for its client trigger ID before retrying.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_DIRECTION_INVALID: The trigger direction is neither ABOVE nor BELOW.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_FIRE_LIMIT_REACHED: The trigger could not fire again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_GENERATIONS_EXHAUSTED: The trigger reached its last modification. Nothing changed; cancel it and create a new trigger instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The account has its maximum number of live and recently ended triggers.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_NOT_MODIFIABLE: Trigger type/state does not support requested lifecycle operation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PATCH_EMPTY: The trigger modify named no field to change.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PATCH_FIELD_UNKNOWN: The trigger modify named a field that is not known.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PATCH_NOT_ALLOWED: A trigger operation other than modify carried field changes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PATCH_PRICE_MODE_INVALID: The trigger modify's price mode is not a known mode.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PATCH_VALUE_UNMASKED: The trigger modify carried a value for a field its change mask does not name.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_INVALID: Trigger-specific error codes (40-49 range). Trigger price is invalid (e.g., TP below current price for long).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: Trigger price source not supported (e.g., INDEX_PRICE before it's available).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_QTY_INVALID: The trigger's child order quantity is not positive.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_STATUS_INVALID: Trigger status does not allow requested lifecycle operation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_SYMBOL_MISMATCH: The request names a listed trading pair other than the trigger's own, so it was refused. Nothing changed; name the trigger's own pair, or omit the symbol. A pair that is not listed is UNKNOWN_SYMBOL.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED: The trigger type is valid but not supported on this venue yet.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_WOULD_TRIGGER_IMMEDIATELY: The change would act on the trigger at once. The new trigger price of a stop-loss or take-profit, or the trigger price a new trailing distance gives an activated trailing stop, is already reached by the price the trigger watches (at or past it), so the trigger would fire at once and send its order; or the new activation price of a trailing stop not yet activated is already reached by that price, so it would activate at once. Nothing changed; the trigger keeps its previous settings. Returned by ModifyTrigger, and by an order modify that moves an attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop of an order with a fill. Choose a price the market has not reached.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP_CAPACITY_REACHED: The market had no room for another TWAP order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP_DURATION_INVALID: The TWAP duration is shorter than 1 second or longer than about 292 years, the longest the venue's clock represents.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP_INTERVAL_INVALID: The TWAP slice interval is shorter than 100 milliseconds or longer than its duration.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_FIELD_SET: The trigger set a field that must be left unset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VALIDATION_ERROR: Request failed structural or cross-field validation.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BASE: BUY-only option: fees are deducted from the received base asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUOTE: Fees are charged in the quote asset. SELL fees always use quote asset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AMENDED: Existing order was amended in place.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REPLACED: Existing order was canceled and replaced with a new order.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AMEND_ONLY: In-place amend only; reject if patch requires replace semantics.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.AMEND_OR_REPLACE: Try in-place amend first; if patch cannot be amended, fall back to replace.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_RISK: Child generated by attached TP/SL/Trailing risk on a parent order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STANDALONE_TRIGGER: Child generated by a standalone trigger (STOP/TWAP/LADDER...).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYSTEM: System-managed automation, such as liquidation or account-protection actions.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FILLED: Fully filled (no remaining quantity). A buy sized by a quote amount (max_quote_debit_scaled) is fully filled once it has spent that amount: what is left of it buys no further quantity step at the next price the order could fill at. Its quantity is then what it bought.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PENDING: Accepted and submitted for execution, but not yet confirmed as working.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PENDING_CANCEL: Cancel requested; may still be working until cancel is confirmed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REJECTED: Rejected and never entered the working state.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WORKING: Accepted and actively working (resting and/or matching).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER: Order was generated by a ladder execution trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STOP_LOSS: Order was generated by a stop-loss trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TAKE_PROFIT: Order was generated by a take-profit trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_STOP: Order was generated by a trailing-stop trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP: Order was generated by a time-weighted execution trigger.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.LIMIT: Limit order with an explicit price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET: Market order executed against available liquidity.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRE_BOTH: Cancel both maker and taker orders on self-trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRE_MAKER: Cancel the resting maker order on self-trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRE_TAKER: Cancel the incoming taker order on self-trade.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BUY: Buy base asset using quote asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELL: Sell base asset for quote asset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.GTD: Good-til-date; the order may remain active only before its exact expiry time.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ABOVE: Fire when price >= trigger_price (e.g., take-profit for long, stop-loss for short).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BELOW: Fire when price <= trigger_price (e.g., stop-loss for long, take-profit for short).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INDEX_PRICE: The market's index price, aggregated from external exchanges. A trigger that watches it acts only on a current index value: while the index is stale or unavailable the trigger stays armed and waits, and never fires on an outdated value.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_PRICE: Last traded price on the market (default for spot).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARK_PRICE: Mark price for perpetuals; not supported on spot markets.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE: The required rate-limit authority could not make a safe decision.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The active weighted quota did not have enough capacity.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT: The authenticated account owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY: The authenticated API key owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.AUTH_SUBJECT: A privacy-preserving normalized public authentication subject owns capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_IP: The normalized client network address owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONNECTION: The active realtime connection owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REGION: The serving region owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SERVICE: The calling service owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT: The selected subaccount owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYMBOL: The trading or market-data symbol owns the capacity.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ADMIN: General account and subaccount administration operations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SECURITY: MFA, recovery, API-key, policy, and security-control mutations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ASSISTANT_CONTROL: Trading assistant controls: cancelling a run, deciding an approval and deleting a memory.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ASSISTANT_MESSAGE: Messages to the trading assistant, each of which starts an assistant run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ASSISTANT_READ: Trading assistant reads, including run event streams.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_CREATE: Deposit-address creation that may call an upstream provider.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PUBLIC_READ: Public market-data and realtime read operations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADING_CANCEL: Trading order and trigger cancellation operations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADING_PLACE: Trading order and trigger placement operations.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONTINUOUS: Capacity refills continuously over the configured policy period.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FIXED_WINDOW: Capacity resets at fixed window boundaries.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ROLLING_WINDOW: Capacity is measured over a rolling time window.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ADMIN: Everything except withdrawals, payout settings, changing the Owner and transferring ownership: only the Owner and Finance withdraw or change payout settings.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.AFFILIATE_MANAGER: Creates affiliate vaults and views balances.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FINANCE: Internal transfers, withdrawals and payout settings.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OWNER: Everything, including withdrawals, payout settings and transferring ownership. Exactly one per broker.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE: The address accepts the first eligible deposit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND_MODE: Entered on the first confirmed deposit. Any further deposit is returned or held and never executes. Ends at address_retires_at. An address that expires unfunded goes from ACTIVE straight to RETIRED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETIRED: The address is retired. A deposit sent to it is not processed automatically; it is handled only through support-assisted recovery, and recovery is not guaranteed.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ELIGIBLE: The eligible deposit that confirmed first. It consumed the QuickSwap and is the only deposit that can execute.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EVALUATING: Detected; eligibility is being evaluated. A deposit can already be credited (credited_at) while it is evaluated.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANUAL_RECOVERY: Observed on an address that was already retired (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED). It never executes and is not returned automatically. It is handled only through support-assisted recovery, and it is potentially unrecoverable. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ON_HOLD: Held for review; it neither executes nor returns until released. A deposit blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED) keeps this disposition after Zipper's compliance team transferred its funds out (QuickSwap CLOSED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN_ONLY: Not accepted: it is returned to return_address and never executes. A deposit found ineligible after it was credited, such as a late deposit (LATE_DEPOSIT), one below min_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) or above max_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM), or one of the wrong asset or network (WRONG_ASSET), keeps credited_at and is returned from its credit.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AFFILIATE: Affiliate fee of one trading leg, one affiliate's bps of what the leg receives, credited to that affiliate vault. Each affiliate has one per leg; on a bridge one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BROKER: Broker fee of one trading leg, the request's broker_bps of what the leg receives, credited to the broker's default vault. A two-leg route has one per leg; a bridge has one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_NETWORK: Network fee withheld from the deposit before it is credited. A quote shows an estimate; the fee withheld is the network's fee when the deposit arrives.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFERRAL: Referral commission of one trading leg: the referral partner's commission_bps (ReferralPricing) of what the leg receives, credited to the partner. It comes out of the broker fee and adds nothing to what the end user pays. Only a request with a referral_code has one; it never appears with AFFILIATE fees. On a bridge one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SERVICE: Service fee of one trading leg: the leg's pair fee in basis points of what the leg receives. A two-leg route has one per leg. On a bridge, the one bridge fee in basis points of the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WITHDRAWAL_NETWORK: Estimated network fee for a withdrawal. The actual fee is charged at withdrawal time and reported on the withdrawal.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BY_DAY: By UTC day the fee was charged.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BY_MONTH: By UTC month the fee was charged.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.STAGE_BROADCAST: A destination-network transaction is known (PayoutStep.tx_hash); the run waits for its withdrawals to complete.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STAGE_PLANNING: Reading the vault's balances to size the payouts.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STAGE_PROCESSING: Every payout due was accepted; no destination-network transaction is known yet.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STAGE_REQUESTING: A payout is waiting to be requested or being requested.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_FAILED: Nothing was paid, and at least one asset's payout failed; reason is the first failure's: withdrawal_refused (refused before any funds left the vault), gateway_capacity_insufficient (the funds stay for a later run), withdrawal_released (released before it was sent; nothing left the vault) or withdrawal_failed (the withdrawal ended without paying, before or after it reached the destination network). Where the funds of a withdrawal_failed payout are now is not shown yet. The step's tx_hash, when set, is its destination-network transaction.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_HELD: Nothing was paid because the rule stopped paying, and the balance stays in the vault. reason is rule_superseded (the rule was paused, changed or replaced before the run paid), or destination_not_whitelisted, destination_invalid or authority_revoked, with which the rule paused itself (see VaultPayoutRule.pause); an Owner or Finance member resumes it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_IN_PROGRESS: The run is under way; stage says where.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_PAID: The run paid: every asset with a payable amount was withdrawn and its withdrawal completed on its destination network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_PARTIALLY_PAID: Some assets were paid and at least one failed; reason is the first failed asset's, and each step shows its own outcome.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_ROLLED_OVER: Nothing was paid, and the balance stays in the vault for the next run. reason is nothing_to_pay (no asset reached its minimum), below_minimum (an amount was below the least a withdrawal on its network pays), price_unavailable (the rule has a USD minimum and no current price valued an asset) or destination_cooling_down (the destination was added to the vault's external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago). Each step carries the balance evaluated, its value and the minimum it was held to.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STEP_COMPLETED: The withdrawal completed on its destination network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STEP_FAILED: The payout failed; reason says why (see PAYOUT_FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STEP_SKIPPED: Nothing was paid for this asset in this run; reason says why, and the balance stays in the vault.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STEP_SUBMITTED: The withdrawal was accepted and waits to complete on its destination network.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE: The deposit arrived and is safe, but processing capacity is temporarily unavailable. Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; no action is needed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM: The deposit is above max_deposit_amount, or above the largest order the route's market accepts. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_ALREADY_USED: The address already accepted its one eligible deposit; this deposit is returned to return_address and never executes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT: The QuickSwap could not be issued a deposit address and never gets one: it is EXPIRED without deposit_instructions, and nothing can be deposited to it. Create a new QuickSwap with a new idempotency key, and report the swap_id to Polyester broker support.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_NOT_ISSUED: The address had not been issued when this deposit was observed; it never executes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED: The address was retired when this deposit was observed. The deposit is MANUAL_RECOVERY: it never executes, is not returned automatically, and is potentially unrecoverable.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM: The deposit is below the published min_deposit_amount, or its credit after the deposit network fee is below the smallest order the route's market accepts. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason. A deposit that cannot be returned on the network it was received on is held (HELD with this reason); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTION_DEADLINE_REACHED: The execution deadline passed before all input executed; untraded funds are refunded or returned. Shown while EXECUTING once the deadline ended trading, and on the payout statuses that follow.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED: The funding window ended without an eligible deposit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERMEDIATE_BELOW_MINIMUM: On a two-leg route, intermediate funds were below the smallest order the second leg's market accepts, so they could not be converted to the destination asset; they are refunded to refund_address. Shown on the payout statuses that follow.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LATE_DEPOSIT: The deposit was first seen after funding_expires_at.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_CLOSED: A market on the route was halted, restricted or delisted when the deposit was credited and did not reopen within a bounded wait after the deposit was credited, the same for market and TWAP execution. Nothing was traded: the deposit is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OUTCOME_RECONCILING: A processing step is being confirmed. Processing resumes automatically; no action is needed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROTECTION_NOT_MET: Execution could not meet the protection; untraded funds are refunded or returned. When no protected order could be placed for the deposit, nothing is traded: the deposit is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM: Refund not possible: an amount left to refund or return was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network, so no withdrawal was made for it. Its withdrawal is NOT_SENT with the amount in unsent_amount. Other withdrawals are unaffected.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED: Polyester's deposit screening blocked the deposit. It is held for compliance review (HELD); it is never executed or returned automatically. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id. If Zipper's compliance team later transfers the funds out to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's, the QuickSwap ends CLOSED with this reason; the funds were not returned to return_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED: The deposit's risk screen failed with a return verdict; the deposit is not accepted and is returned to return_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WITHDRAWAL_FAILED: A withdrawal cannot be completed and is held for review. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WRONG_ASSET: The deposit is not the quoted source asset or network. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address on the network and in the asset it was received in, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason. A deposit that cannot be returned there, such as one received on a network where return_address is not valid, is held (HELD with this reason); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ALLOCATING: The quote is fixed and the deposit address is being allocated. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE, allocation continues automatically until an address frees up; the wait has no fixed bound.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.AWAITING_DEPOSIT: Quote and deposit address allocated; waiting for the first eligible deposit before funding_expires_at.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLOSED: Terminal: the deposit was blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED), and Zipper's compliance team transferred the funds out on the deposit's network to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's. Nothing was returned to return_address or refunded. Its one withdrawal is that COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, FINALIZED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Terminal: every withdrawal is final (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT) and at least one is a DESTINATION withdrawal. A DESTINATION withdrawal is never NOT_SENT.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMING: Waiting for source confirmations and deposit validation before credit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREDITED: The deposit is credited; execution is starting.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTING: The credited deposit is being traded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRED: Terminal: the funding window ended without an eligible deposit (FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED), or the QuickSwap never got a deposit address (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HELD: Funds are held for review. Not terminal: review resumes the QuickSwap or returns the funds, or, for SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED, the QuickSwap can end CLOSED. reason says why when a specific reason applies, else it is REASON_UNSPECIFIED. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYING_OUT: Execution finished with destination output; withdrawals, including any partial refund or return, are in progress.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PREPARING_DEPOSIT: The deposit is being prepared for credit. Retries keep this status.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUNDED: Terminal: every withdrawal is final, none is DESTINATION, and at least one is REFUND (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUNDING: A two-leg route produced no destination output; the intermediate asset is being refunded to refund_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURNED: Terminal: every withdrawal is final and all are RETURN (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURNING: Nothing was traded or the deposit was not accepted; the source funds are being returned to return_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WAITING_FOR_CAPACITY: An eligible deposit arrived and is safe; waiting for processing capacity. Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; the wait has no fixed bound.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DESTINATION_AMOUNT: amount is the destination amount the end user wants to receive after fees, in destination token units. The quote reports the deposit amount needed at the quoted price. The delivered amount still follows the actual deposit and execution, bounded below by the protection.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_AMOUNT: amount is the source amount the end user intends to deposit, in source token units.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.VAULT_ACTIVE: New QuickSwaps can credit the vault.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VAULT_DISABLED: New QuickSwaps naming the vault are refused with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN. QuickSwaps already created still credit it.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER: A deposit blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED) that Zipper's compliance team transferred out on the network it was received on, to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's. Not a return or a refund: Polyester records neither the recipient nor the amount, so address, memo, amount and network_fee are unset; tx_hash is the transfer, and flow_id the deposit's flow.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DESTINATION: Swap output to destination_address on the destination network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND: Untraded intermediate asset of a two-leg route, including a partial refund, to refund_address on the refund route's network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN: Source funds that were not accepted or not traded, to return_address on the network and in the asset they were received in: the source network, or for a wrong asset the network it was sent on.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Definitively failed. The QuickSwap is HELD (WITHDRAWAL_FAILED); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_SENT: Final: no transaction was or will be made for this withdrawal, because its amount was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network (REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM); unsent_amount is that amount.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUEUED: Approved and waiting to be submitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Submitted to the recipient's network; not yet final.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: The transfer request was accepted and has a durable transfer identifier.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: The transfer request failed terminally before durable acceptance.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REJECTED: The transfer request was rejected before durable acceptance.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_REPAIR: Ended by the exchange while it recovered your account. The account's open orders on the market were canceled at the same time; place new orders and triggers once the account trades again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: An internal invariant or processing failure canceled the trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_HALTED: The market was halted: the exchange ended every open trigger of the market, attached take-profit and stop-loss included, and released its reserved funds. The market's open orders were canceled at the same time. The market refuses new triggers until it trades again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MISSING_REASON_CODE: The terminal state did not contain a cancellation reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OCO: An attached leg ended because its parent order is terminal and another of the parent's legs made the last exit, leaving no position to protect.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_ATTACHED_LEG: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the order's attached take-profit or stop-loss and canceled the order and its working exit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_LADDER: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the ladder and canceled its resting levels, releasing their reserved funds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_TRIGGER: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the stop-loss, take-profit or trailing stop and released its reserved funds. The market's open orders were canceled at the same time.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_TWAP: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the TWAP and canceled its resting slice, releasing its reserved funds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARENT_CANCELED_NO_FILL: The parent order ended without a fill, so its attached trigger was canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELF_TRADE_PREVENTION: Self-trade prevention canceled the trigger's child orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.USER_REQUEST: The user explicitly canceled the trigger, or canceled an order that ended it, alone, with a cancel-all or by the dead-man switch: an attached leg's working exit (with oco set, the parent's other legs end with it), or a level of a ladder that ended with nothing filled.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACTIVATED: A trailing stop's activation condition was satisfied and tracking began, for a standalone or an attached trailing stop.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ARMED: An attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop started protecting its parent order's filled quantity, once, when the parent's first fill made it live (or at its resume, when it was paused before that fill). Later fills that resize it, and later pauses and resumes, do not repeat it. An attached trailing stop still reports ACTIVATED when it starts tracking.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Trigger became terminal after its next child order could not be admitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FIRED: Trigger fired and may have created a child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FIRE_REFUSED: A fire of the trigger was refused and the trigger stayed live: an attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop waits for the next price through its trigger price, or, refused because its order would be below the market's minimums, waits until its position changes; a trigger refused for a rate limit or an account repair fires again shortly. An attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop whose order self-trade prevention expired against another of the account's resting orders stays live too (SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED), reported once while that order blocks it. New trades and price updates do not fire it while the other order is first in line at the best price; once that order is gone or no longer first there, it fires again if its trigger condition still holds. Not terminal: the trigger keeps its status. child_seq names the refused attempt, which placed no child order, and fire_refusal_reason says why; the next fire takes the next child_seq. With SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED, child_seq names the expired child order instead, which was placed and canceled by self-trade prevention. A refusal that ends the trigger is FAILED instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UPDATED: Trigger configuration or lifecycle state was updated.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_REPAIRING: The account was under an automatic repair, so the fire was retried shortly instead of placing its child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ROUTING_INVALID: The trigger could not be installed on its market's current route.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: The account associated with the trigger was not recognized.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_LEGS_EXCEEDED: The order carried more attached legs than allowed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_ORDER_INCONSISTENT: The trigger's child order did not match the order the trigger requested, so the trigger failed and the child order was canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_QTY_RAISE_NOT_ALLOWED: One of the trigger's child orders went past its planned quantity, so the trigger ended.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_ORDER_IDS_EXHAUSTED: The account reserved its maximum number of client order IDs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID_INVALID: The client trigger ID was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_FLAGS_INVALID: The trigger's condition flags were not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_PARAMETER_SET: The trigger set a condition parameter its condition does not take.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: An idempotency key was reused with different request details.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ID: The child order reused a client order ID that was already accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID: The child order's identifier was already in use by another order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EMPTY_BOOK: The order book had no liquidity available for the child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ENGINE_BUSY: The market could not accept the child order at that time.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_INVALID: The fee asset was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_NOT_ALLOWED: The selected fee asset was not permitted for the child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_CEILING_EXCEEDED: The applicable fee rate exceeded the maximum accepted by the trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_CEILING_INVALID: The trigger's maximum fee rate was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE: The fees that apply to the child order could not be determined.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FOK_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: The order book could not fill the entire fill-or-kill child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INDEX_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: The trigger watches the index price and the market has no index price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The account did not have enough available funds for the child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: An internal invariant or processing failure caused the trigger to fail.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_FLAGS: The child order's flags were not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_ID: The child order's identifier was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_TYPE: The child order's type was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SIDE: The child order's side was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SIZING: The child order sizing fields did not form a valid sizing request.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_STP_MODE: The child order's self-trade prevention mode was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIME_IN_FORCE: The child order's time in force was not accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_LEVELS_INVALID: The ladder's number of levels was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_RANGE_TOO_NARROW: The ladder's price range was too narrow for its number of levels.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LIMIT_CHILD_SLIPPAGE_SET: The trigger set a slippage bound on a LIMIT child order.
